title: Lead - AOCC&JCC
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - AOCC/JCC is responsible for managing operational activities at the AOCC and JCC, ensuring seamless coordination of real-time airport functions. This role focuses on resource allocation, proactive problem resolution, and maintaining smooth communication with stakeholders to uphold operational standards and deliver a superior passenger experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operation Management:**
Oversee daily operations at the AOCC and JCC during shifts to ensure smooth functioning of airport systems, including flight operations, baggage handling, and passenger management.
  
  
Monitor and coordinate real-time operational data to maintain high On-Time Performance (OTP), proactively addressing delays or disruptions.
  
  
Oversee the allocation of airport resources such as check-in counters, boarding gates, parking stands, and conveyor belts to optimize asset utilization.
  
  
Manage Flight Information Display Systems (FIDS) to display real-time, accurate information for passengers and stakeholders.
  
  
Monitor and notify stakeholders of adverse weather warnings and implement Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) during weather disruptions to ensure safe operations.
  
  
**Crisis Management And Incident Response**
Develop and implement crisis management plans to effectively respond to emergencies such as security threats, medical incidents, and operational disruptions.
  
  
Ensure the effective implementation of Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) and maintain close coordination with ATC during weather challenges.
  
  
Provide training and conduct regular drills with AOCC/JCC staff for better preparedness during emergencies.
  
  
**Resource Allocation and Utilization:**
Allocate and manage resources such as personnel, equipment, and technology within the AOCC to ensure optimal utilization and operational efficiency.
  
  
Monitor resource usage including ground support equipment and personnel deployment, addressing any issues related to allocation, availability, and maintenance.
  
  
**Compliance And Regulatory Oversight**
Ensure strict adherence to the Operational Management Development Agreement (OMDA) and comply with guidelines from government agencies and regulatory bodies (e.g., DGCA, AAI).
  
  
Implement and monitor the Noise Abatement Plan to mitigate the environmental impact of airport operations, aligning with prescribed standards and ensuring regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Documentation And Reporting**
Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all operational activities, events, and incidents to maintain an updated operational record.
  
  
Generate and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly reports related to airport performance, On-Time Performance (OTP), resource utilization, and emergency management.
  
  
Oversee the maintenance of MIS systems to ensure that operational data is captured correctly for aero invoicing and compliance audits.
  
  
Prepare comprehensive reports on disruptions, emergencies, and performance trends for internal review and management decision-making.
  
  
**Team Leadership And Development**
Lead and mentor team members within the AOCC/JCC, providing guidance on best practices in airport operations, emergency response, and customer service standards.
  
  
Conduct performance evaluations and implement professional development plans for team members, ensuring adherence to industry regulations and performance benchmarks.
  
  
**Stakeholder Coordination And Communication**
Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including airlines, ground services, security, and customs, to ensure smooth operations and address any issues that arise within the AOCC.
  
  
Facilitate communication and collaboration between the AOCC and other JCC departments to resolve operational challenges, improve efficiency, and enhance passenger experience.
  
  
**Process Improvement**
Support in the execution of Business Excellence programs focusing on process improvement, energy-saving initiatives, and operational efficiency during shift operations.
  
  
Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of Business Continuity Management Systems (BCMS) to ensure uninterrupted airport operations in case of emergencies.
  
  
Assist in DA-CDM (Domestic Airport Collaborative Decision Making) implementation to improve operational coordination between stakeholders and enhance On-Time Performance (OTP).
  
  
**Digital Mindset**
Use real-time dashboards, data analytics, and collaborative decision-making tools to enhance operational efficiency.
  
  
Ensure accurate data capture for generating MIS reports and aero invoicing for operational reconciliation.
  
  
Monitor the use of digital platforms like A-CDM to streamline collaboration with stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Head - AOCC/JCC
  
  
Direct Supervisors & other Department Leaders
  
  
Airport Operations Team
  
  
Air Traffic Control
  
  
Airport Security
  
  
Emergency Medical Services
  
  
Engineering & Maintenance Team
  
  
Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)
  
  
Airports Authority of India
  
  
Ministry of Civil Aviation
  
  
Airlines
  
  
Ground Handling Agencies
  
  
Service providers
  
  
Govt. agencies (CISF/ATC)
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**
Bachelor's Degree in Aviation Management, Business Administration, or a related field
  
  
Master's Degree in a relevant field is preferred.
  
  
**Work Experience**
10+ years of relevant experience in managing operations at a control centre

**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Energy Solutions Limited:**
Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) is a leading player in India’s power transmission and energy infrastructure sector, enabling seamless and efficient energy flow across the nation. With a strong presence in both operational and under-construction projects, AESL manages over 20,000 circuit kilometers of transmission lines and substations. As a part of the Adani Group, AESL is driven by the philosophy of #GrowthWithGoodness, aiming to build a sustainable and resilient energy future. Through digital innovation, smart grid deployment, and a commitment to ESG excellence, AESL plays a vital role in strengthening India’s energy security and powering inclusive growth.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Project Transmission Line Manager (Site)-Tx is responsible for executing assigned segments of high-voltage (765/400 kV) transmission line projects with required productivity and alignment with established timelines, budget, and quality standards. This role emphasizes zero-harm principles and adherence to processes, ensuring regulatory compliance, and efficient project progression through proactive site management, quality control, and safety adherence. Additionally, the role involves effective coordination with stakeholders, administrative support, and fostering a collaborative, skilled team environment to drive successful project completion.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Project Transmission Line Manager (Site)-Tx**
**Project Management**
Drive successful execution of the transmission line section by planning, monitoring, and coordinating foundation, erection, and stringing activities to align with project schedules and quality standards.
  
  
Ensure effective tower placement and routing by reviewing survey data and field conditions, verifying critical details such as extension needs and crossing points (NH, Railway).
  
  
Prepare and maintain L2 schedules by planning weekly and monthly workforce and material needs, contributing to consistent project progression.
  
  
Provide comprehensive reporting by delivering daily and monthly MIS to meet management's requirements for project updates.
  
  
Ensure quality compliance by implementing Field Quality Plans (FQP) and IS Codes/CBIP manuals at the site and certifying all material and work quality against established standards.
  
  
**Compliance Management**
Safeguard the project site through strict adherence to safety protocols by implementing OHS plans and conducting safety training programs at regular intervals.
  
  
Promote ongoing compliance with regulatory standards by conducting regular quality and safety inspections, mitigating any potential risks.
  
  
Maintain up-to-date documentation by preparing compensation records, landowner agreements, and administrative records, ensuring all necessary approvals to avoid penalties.
  
  
**Liaison And Stakeholder Management**
Facilitate a smooth work environment by collaborating with government authorities and securing assistance from administrative officers (Patwari, Tehsildar, SDM) for landowner and ROW matters.
  
  
Coordinate effectively with vendors and contractors by holding regular project meetings to resolve critical issues, avoiding additional costs, and ensuring aligned objectives.
  
  
Maintain open communication with stakeholders by engaging with local authorities, arranging shutdowns, and securing necessary permissions for timely project execution.
  
  
**Financial Management**
Support budget adherence by closely tracking expenses, managing resources, and monitoring project costs against allocated budgets.
  
  
Maintain cost efficiency by overseeing expense allocations and managing vendor bills for accuracy, approvals, and timely processing.
  
  
**Risk Management**
Ensure a zero-harm work environment by rigorously implementing safety protocols and conducting regular safety checks to identify and address potential hazards on-site.
  
  
Mitigate compliance risks by conducting thorough quality assessments, ensuring all activities align with regulatory standards and project specifications.
  
  
**Technology Integration And Innovation**
Enhance project efficiency by utilizing advanced project management software and tools for real-time tracking of progress, resource allocation, and communication among team members.
  
  
Drive quality improvement initiatives by integrating innovative techniques and technologies, thereby elevating project execution standards and outcomes.

**Educational Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering.
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
10-12 years of relevant experience in high-voltage (765/400 kV) transmission line project execution.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Production

Specialization: Automotive Manufacturing | Rubber Moulding | Shop-Floor Operations

Company: Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Chhatral, Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Experience: 3–7 Years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a relevant discipline

Industry Preference: Automobile / Automotive Components Manufacturing

About Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing and engineering company specializing in precision-engineered components and manufacturing solutions. With a focus on quality, productivity, automation, and continuous improvement, we serve demanding industrial and OEM customers through reliable manufacturing capabilities and process-driven operations.

Visit us: https://www.schilthornprecision.com/

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer – Production with experience in the automobile or automotive components industry, particularly in rubber moulding and related manufacturing processes.

The ideal candidate should have strong shop-floor exposure, a practical understanding of production processes, and the ability to manage manpower, machines, productivity, quality, and delivery commitments. The candidate must be capable of identifying production bottlenecks, resolving process-related issues, reducing rejection and downtime, and driving continuous improvement.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can take ownership of daily production performance and deliver measurable improvements in manufacturing efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Planning & Shop-Floor Execution

Execute daily and monthly production plans in line with customer requirements and dispatch schedules.

Monitor production output against targets, identify bottlenecks, and take corrective action to achieve planned productivity.

Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machines, tools, moulds, raw materials, and other production resources.

Coordinate with Planning, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth production flow.

Monitor shift-wise production, work-in-progress, downtime, rejection, and pending orders.

2. Rubber Moulding & Manufacturing Process Control

Manage and monitor rubber moulding operations, where applicable, including process parameters, mould condition, cycle time, and output.

Understand critical moulding parameters such as temperature, pressure, curing time, material preparation, and demoulding.

Identify and troubleshoot process defects such as flash, short moulding, air traps, dimensional variation, and other moulding-related rejections.

Ensure correct machine setup, mould changeover, process settings, and first-piece approval before starting production.

Maintain process consistency and work with Quality and Maintenance teams to minimize mould-related issues and unplanned downtime.

Support process validation, trial runs, new product introduction, and process stabilization.

3. Exposure to Other Manufacturing Processes

Coordinate and control production activities involving relevant processes such as CNC machining, turning, drilling, cutting, fabrication, assembly, or other component-manufacturing operations, depending on product requirements.

Understand process flow, machine capability, tooling requirements, cycle time, and quality checkpoints.

Ensure standard operating procedures and approved process parameters are followed.

Identify opportunities to simplify operations, improve machine utilization, and reduce material wastage.

4. Quality & Rejection Control

Ensure production conforms to approved drawings, specifications, control plans, and customer quality requirements.

Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and process deviations; initiate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Apply problem-solving tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and 8D, in coordination with the Quality team.

Ensure adherence to in-process inspection, first-piece approval, traceability, and process documentation requirements.

Support customer complaint resolution and corrective/preventive action implementation.

5. Productivity & Continuous Improvement

Track and improve key production KPIs, including output, cycle time, rejection percentage, machine downtime, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Drive initiatives to reduce cycle time, improve yield, minimize changeover time, and eliminate production losses.

Implement 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and other practical shop-floor improvement initiatives.

Analyze recurring production problems and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Support cost reduction through improved process efficiency, manpower utilization, and material consumption.

6. Manpower & Team Management

Allocate operators and workers according to production plans, machine requirements, and skill levels.

Monitor operator performance, attendance, discipline, and adherence to standard work practices.

Train operators on machine operation, process parameters, quality requirements, and safe working practices.

Ensure shift handovers are effective and production issues are communicated clearly.

Build a culture of accountability, productivity, quality ownership, and teamwork.

7. Maintenance, Safety & Documentation

Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive maintenance, breakdown resolution, and reduction of machine downtime.

title: Specialist Pilot line Formation

Manage the Formation team on the Pilot Line to execute trial builds and chemistry changeovers (e.g., LFP to NMC or other emerging chemistries), achieving trial-run SQDC KPIs. title: Head of Production
description:
Job Opening: Head of Production – BESS Manufacturing

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited

Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited is engaged in renewable energy and energy storage solutions,

specializing in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and customized energy storage solutions

for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. We are committed to

delivering reliable, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Head of Production – BESS Manufacturing

to lead and oversee manufacturing operations for Battery Energy Storage Systems at our

Ahmedabad facility. The ideal candidate will have 15+ years of experience in manufacturing and

production management, preferably in BESS, battery pack manufacturing, lithium-ion battery

systems, electrical equipment, or related industries.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end production planning and execution,

manufacturing process development, product quality, resource optimization, team leadership, and

continuous improvement to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality BESS products in

accordance with technical specifications and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• BESS Manufacturing Operations: Lead end-to-end manufacturing and assembly of

Battery Energy Storage Systems, including battery modules and packs, battery

enclosures, electrical integration, and associated subsystems, as applicable to the product

design.

• Production Planning & Execution: Develop production plans, schedules, capacity

plans, and targets to ensure timely execution and delivery of manufacturing orders.

• Manufacturing Process Development: Establish and standardize assembly processes,

work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and production workflows.

• Battery System Integration: Coordinate manufacturing and integration activities

involving Battery Management Systems (BMS), power conversion systems (PCS),

thermal management, electrical protection, and auxiliary systems, as applicable.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop production engineers, supervisors, technicians, and

shop-floor personnel to achieve operational and quality objectives.

• Process Optimization: Identify production bottlenecks, improve cycle times, minimize

material wastage, and enhance manufacturing productivity.

• Quality Assurance: Work closely with Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams to

ensure product conformity, traceability, inspection compliance, and reduction of defects

and rework.

• Safety Management: Ensure adherence to battery handling, electrical safety, ESD

controls where applicable, fire prevention, and other relevant manufacturing safety

procedures.

• Resource & Capacity Management: Optimize manpower, equipment, tools, production

capacity, and material utilization to achieve manufacturing targets.

• Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination: Collaborate with Procurement, Stores,

Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to ensure the timely availability of battery cells,

electrical components, enclosures, cables, and other production materials.

• Testing & Validation Coordination: Coordinate with Engineering and Quality teams for

functional testing, inspection, and production acceptance of manufactured BESS units.

• Cost Control: Monitor manufacturing costs, reduce scrap and rework, and improve

overall operational efficiency.

• Continuous Improvement: Implement lean manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and other

continuous improvement methodologies.

• Performance Monitoring: Establish and track KPIs related to production output, yield,

cycle time, rejection rates, equipment downtime, and on-time delivery.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, Design Engineering,

Quality, Procurement, Maintenance, and Project teams to resolve manufacturing

challenges and support new product introduction.

• Management Reporting: Present production performance, capacity utilization, quality

trends, resource requirements, and improvement plans to senior management.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Master's degree or PhD in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, Production

Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 15 years of experience in manufacturing and production management,

preferably with substantial experience in BESS, battery systems, or electrical equipment

manufacturing.

• Proven experience in leading factory operations and managing end-to-end manufacturing

processes.

• Strong understanding of battery pack assembly, electrical integration, manufacturing

workflows, and production quality requirements.

• Familiarity with BMS, PCS, battery enclosures, thermal management, and associated

electrical subsystems.

• Experience in production planning, capacity management, process optimization, and cost

control.

• Knowledge of manufacturing quality systems, product traceability, inspection procedures,

and relevant safety requirements.

• Experience in implementing production KPIs, lean manufacturing, 5S, and continuous

improvement initiatives.

• Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making

skills.

Preferred Skills & Industry Experience

• Hands-on experience in BESS manufacturing, lithium-ion battery pack assembly, battery

energy storage integration, or battery system production.

• Experience in electrical panels, switchgear, power electronics, UPS, inverters, or

industrial electrical equipment manufacturing.

• Exposure to new product introduction (NPI), design-for-manufacturing (DFM), and

production process validation.

• Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, manufacturing documentation, and production

reporting tools.

• Ability to coordinate effectively with R&D, Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Stores,

and Supply Chain teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Achievement of production targets and delivery schedules.

• Improvement in production yield and manufacturing efficiency.

• Reduction in defects, rework, scrap, and material wastage.

• Compliance with quality, traceability, and battery safety requirements.

• Effective utilization of manpower, equipment, and production capacity.

• Successful implementation of standardized manufacturing processes.

• Timely resolution of production issues and support for new product introduction.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with 15+ years of relevant experience in BESS, battery manufacturing, or

electrical equipment manufacturing are invited to apply through LinkedIn with their updated

resume

Nimaya is a future-ready not-for-profit cofounded in 2021 by Navya Nanda and Samyak Chakrabarty, focused on preparing young women facing socio-economic barriers for a world of work being rapidly reshaped by AI and emerging technologies. As GenAI transforms industries, workflows and hiring expectations, Nimaya works at the intersection of employability and AI readiness to ensure our Nimaya Naaris are not replaced by AI, but instead are equipped to participate and lead in this new economy. • Building Chatbots & training Agentic AIs

• AI-powered research & communication tactics

• Creative problem-solving

• Presentation & collaboration skills

• Real-world projects & mentorship The goal is not just to teach AI tools but to make learners truly future-ready for what the modern workplace demands: the ability to confidently work with AI instead of feeling threatened by it.

• Upskill 900 young women across Ahmedabad

• Expand GenAI learning to areas where access to AI exposure is still limited

• Familiarity with handling compliance, documentation, and structured reporting systems

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Role**
This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.
  
  
Technical RFP Analysis
  
  

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

Solution Shaping
  
  

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

Estimation & Delivery Planning
  
  

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

Technical Proposal Development
  
  

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity
  
  

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

Reusable Solution Assets
  
  

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

title: General Manager
description:
**General Manager – Housekeeping & Facility Services**

**Company:**
 The Cleaning Company

**Location:**
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to:**
 Director

**Joining:**
 Immediate or early joiners preferred

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on General Manager to lead our housekeeping manpower and deep cleaning business. You will take ownership of daily operations, team performance, client satisfaction, collections, profitability and business growth.

This role requires someone who can independently manage office and field teams, visit client sites, resolve problems and maintain clear accountability through regular reporting to the Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Lead daily operations across housekeeping contracts and deep cleaning assignments, ensuring adequate manpower, service quality and timely execution.

• Manage operations managers, field officers, supervisors and office teams, with clear responsibilities and performance reviews.

• Work with HR on recruitment, deployment, attendance, retention, training and workforce discipline.

• Maintain client relationships, conduct review meetings, resolve complaints and improve contract renewals.

• Review site profitability, control overtime and operating expenses, and identify underperforming contracts.

• Coordinate with accounts to ensure accurate billing, timely collections and resolution of outstanding payments.

• Support new business, quotations, contract negotiations, upselling and mobilisation of new sites.

• Implement SOPs, site audits, safety practices and compliance processes with the relevant teams.

• Improve the use of digital attendance, reporting and operational tools.

• Submit a weekly dashboard covering operations, manpower, clients, sales, collections, profitability and priority actions.

**What We Are Looking For**

• Preferably 8+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years managing multiple sites and teams.

• Strong experience in housekeeping, facility management, contract staffing or a closely related service business.

• Demonstrated responsibility for budgets, profitability, collections and client retention.

• Ability to lead a large frontline workforce and handle operational escalations independently.

• Confidence with spreadsheets, management reports and digital tools.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills. Gujarati, Hindi and English proficiency preferred.

• Willingness to work from Ahmedabad and travel to client sites as required.

**Initial Priorities**

Assess operations and site profitability, stabilise manpower, strengthen client relationships, improve collections and establish clear team accountability and reporting.

**Compensation**

To be discussed based on relevant experience, demonstrated results and role fit.

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn or email your CV to Director@thecleaning.company with the subject:

**Application – General Manager – [Your Name]**

Please include your expected CTC, notice period, current location, and a brief summary of the number of sites and employees you have managed.

title: General Manager
description:
Job Title: General Manager – Accounts, Finance & Operations

**Company:**
Signature Financial Advisory LLP

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, On-site

Company Description

Signature Financial Advisory LLP is a financial services firm focused on providing personalized financial advisory and wealth management solutions to individuals and businesses. We are committed to helping clients achieve their financial goals through disciplined financial planning, informed investment strategies, and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

We value integrity, transparency, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and long-term client relationships. We are looking for a capable, dependable, and hands-on General Manager who can oversee the firm's day-to-day functioning and independently manage its accounting, taxation, compliance coordination, administration, technology, and other managerial responsibilities.

Role Description

The General Manager – Accounts, Finance & Operations will be responsible for managing the overall operations of Signature Financial Advisory LLP, ensuring smooth business functioning, accurate financial records, timely statutory compliance, and efficient coordination across all departments.

We are looking for an
**all-rounder who can take ownership of multiple business functions**
, handle routine accounting and taxation matters, coordinate with external professionals wherever required, resolve operational issues, and work closely with the partners to keep the firm organized, compliant, and efficient.

The ideal candidate should be practical, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities1. Accounts and Financial Management

* Manage day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations.
* Prepare and maintain profit and loss statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.
* Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense tracking, payment processing, and vendor accounts.
* Monitor cash flow, budgets, expenses, and financial performance.
* Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation of all transactions.
* Coordinate with auditors, chartered accountants, banks, and other financial institutions as required.

2. GST, Income Tax and Statutory Compliance

* Manage GST-related activities, including invoice verification, input tax credit reconciliation, preparation of GST workings, and coordination and filing of applicable GST returns.
* Handle income tax-related work, including tax computations, advance tax calculations, TDS compliance, and preparation and coordination of income tax return filings.
* Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, reconciliations, and applicable returns.
* Maintain statutory registers, tax records, supporting documents, and compliance calendars.
* Track filing deadlines, tax payments, notices, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the firm's chartered accountant and tax consultants for audits, assessments, tax notices, and complex compliance matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial, taxation, and regulatory requirements.

3. Office Administration and General Management

* Oversee the firm's daily administrative activities and ensure smooth office operations.
* Manage vendors, service providers, office expenses, procurement, and facility-related requirements.
* Develop and implement internal processes, policies, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain documentation, contracts, records, and confidential company information.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.

4. IT, Systems and Technology Management

* Oversee office IT infrastructure, computers, software, internet connectivity, email systems, printers, and other technology requirements.
* Coordinate with IT vendors and service providers for troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades.
* Manage software subscriptions, user access, data backups, and basic cybersecurity practices.
* Ensure proper access controls and confidentiality of financial and client information.
* Identify opportunities to automate accounting, reporting, documentation, and administrative workflows.

5. HR and Team Management

* Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave records, and employee documentation.
* Support payroll processing and coordinate salary-related statutory compliance.
* Set employee responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure accountability.
* Supervise and coordinate with team members, resolve routine workplace issues, and promote a professional work environment.
* Coordinate training, internal communication, and implementation of company policies.

6. Business Operations and Management Reporting

* Prepare periodic management reports covering expenses, revenue, cash flow, compliance status, and operational performance.
* Monitor key business metrics and provide timely updates to the partners.
* Assist in budgeting, resource planning, cost control, and business planning.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of operational and administrative tasks.
* Identify risks, follow up on pending matters, and proactively resolve issues before they affect business operations.

7. Client and Professional Coordination

* Coordinate with clients, vendors, banks, auditors, chartered accountants, tax consultants, and other professional service providers.
* Support client servicing and ensure timely follow-up on documentation and operational requirements.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure confidentiality in all business dealings.
* Support the partners in implementing business priorities and improving the overall client experience.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.
* Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in accounting, taxation, finance, administration, or general management, preferably in a small or medium-sized organization.
* Strong practical knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, financial statements, and bank reconciliations.
* Hands-on knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax compliance, and statutory filing procedures.
* Experience using accounting software such as Tally Prime, along with MS Excel and other business applications.
* Working knowledge of payroll, budgeting, vendor management, and office administration.
* Ability to coordinate IT systems and external service providers effectively.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accuracy, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently and meet deadlines.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a
**hands-on General Manager who can manage accounts, taxation, compliance, IT coordination, HR administration, and general office operations under one roof.**

**We prefer someone who has worked in a CA firm, financial services company, consultancy, or SME environment and understands how to manage the practical, day-to-day requirements of a business.**

**The candidate should be comfortable handling routine work personally instead of only delegating tasks. They should also know when to seek support from a chartered accountant, tax expert, IT specialist, or legal professional for complex matters.**

**The role requires a self-driven individual who takes ownership, follows up without constant supervision, maintains accurate records, anticipates deadlines, and ensures that nothing important is overlooked.**

Key Performance Expectations

* Timely and accurate accounting, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* GST, TDS, income tax, and other applicable compliance completed within prescribed deadlines.
* Accurate financial records and readiness for audits and assessments.
* Effective expense control, cash flow monitoring, and vendor management.
* Smooth functioning of office systems, IT coordination, and administrative processes.
* Timely payroll and employee documentation, as applicable.
* Reliable management reporting and regular updates to the partners.
* Strong ownership, accountability, confidentiality, and minimal need for day-to-day supervision.

**Work Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

* **Work Arrangement:**
  Full-time, on-site

title: Manager, Manufacturing Injectables
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The role is responsible for ensuring strict cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices) compliance and overseeing end-to-end injectable manufacturing operations for the assigned production line. The role involves supervising aseptic manufacturing activities, ensuring adherence to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices) across General, Control, and Aseptic areas. The position is accountable for equipment and line validation status, change control, deviation management, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) implementation. The role also leads SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) lifecycle management, production planning versus actual performance monitoring, and regulatory readiness. Additionally, the role requires maintaining accurate online documentation systems and aligning operations with USFDA (United States Food and Drug Administration) and ICH (International Council for Harmonisation) requirements.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Ensure and monitor all GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices) activities, including cleaning and sanitization, across General, Control, and Aseptic areas
* Supervise overall injectable manufacturing operations during assigned shifts, ensuring aseptic compliance
* Ensure all equipment and manufacturing lines are validated and calibrated as per approved schedules
* Generate and track general purchase indents for departmental consumables and production items
* Handle Change Control, Deviations, Investigations, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) in coordination with QA
* Prepare, review, revise, control, and implement SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for sterile manufacturing operations
* Prepare production plan vs actual reports on daily and monthly basis based on material availability
* Ensure strict adherence to aseptic techniques and sterilization processes during injectable manufacturing
* Monitor CPPs (Critical Process Parameters) and CQAs (Critical Quality Attributes) during batch execution
* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with USFDA and ICH guidelines
* Responsible for preparation & review of the all-master documents of production
* Responsible to update on self-hygiene
* Responsible to attend the training as per training schedule and to ensure training of the team as per TNI

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Responsible to give training to all the subordinates, technicians, and operators of the department.
* Activities other than defined in the Job responsibility are to be done, as per the requirement of HOD, by following HODs instruction and guidance.
* Responsible to attend the training as per training schedule and to ensure training as per TNI.

**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* B. Pharm B. Pharm - Required
* M. Pharm M. Pharm - Preferred

**Experience:**

* 12 years or more in 12 - 15 Years

**Licenses:**

title: Senior Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Senior Manager - Regulatory & Commercial (ERCG)**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
  
  
Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
  
  
Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
  
  
Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
  
  
Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
  
  
Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
  
  
**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
  
  
In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
  
  
Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
  
  
Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
  
  
Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
  
  
**Portal Management**
Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
  
  
Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
  
  
Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
  
  
Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
  
  
Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
  
  
**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
  
  
Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
  
  
Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
  
  
**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
  
  
Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
  
  
In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

title: General Manager - Land Acquisition
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate end-to-end land acquisition activities with the Site Land Team, Head Office, Legal, Projects, Finance, Commercial, EPC, and Business Development teams.
* Support identification, evaluation, and finalization of suitable land parcels for renewable energy projects, including solar, wind, hybrid parks, pooling substations, transmission corridors, access roads, laydown areas, and project infrastructure.
* Facilitate land due diligence including title verification, ownership checks, encumbrance review, revenue record verification, mutation status, land use classification, zoning, litigation checks, and verification of government restrictions.
* Coordinate land purchase, lease, right-of-use, easement, wayleave, and Right of Way documentation as per project requirements.
* Monitor land aggregation progress, landowner negotiations, consent collection, agreement execution, registration, stamp duty, mutation, demarcation, possession, and handover of land to project execution teams.
* Track and support statutory approvals, permits, NOCs, conversions, and clearances from revenue, forest, local administration, panchayat, DISCOM, state nodal agencies, pollution control, highways, railways, defence, airport authority, and other relevant authorities.
* Coordinate resolution of site-level issues including boundary disputes, encroachments, access constraints, community concerns, compensation-related matters, crop damages, and local stakeholder resistance.
* Maintain updated land MIS, approval trackers, agreement records, ownership documents, khasra/khatauni/7-12 extracts, FMB sketches, maps, survey reports, mutation records, land schedules, litigation status, and compliance documentation.
* Ensure adherence to applicable land laws, revenue laws, renewable energy policy guidelines, land ceiling provisions, forest and environmental regulations, local authority requirements, and internal governance processes.
* Act as the single coordination point between site and Head Office for escalation, reporting, review meetings, documentation closure, approval follow-ups, and project land readiness status.

Land & Estate Scope
  
  

* Land sourcing, land aggregation, land acquisition, land leasing, and land pooling coordination.
* Title search, legal due diligence, revenue due diligence, technical feasibility, boundary verification, site survey, demarcation, and possession.
* Land conversion, non-agriculture permission, change of land use, mutation, registration, encumbrance clearance, and land record updation.
* ROW, access road permissions, transmission line corridor coordination, pooling substation land, approach road land, and site infrastructure land requirements.
* Government liaisoning, statutory approvals, local administration coordination, panchayat interface, community engagement, and dispute resolution.
* Land documentation, agreement management, lease deeds, sale deeds, consent letters, affidavits, indemnities, NOCs, approval letters, and MIS reporting.

Technical Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of land acquisition, land aggregation, land revenue records, title due diligence, mutation, registration, stamp duty, and land conversion processes.
* Knowledge of renewable energy project land requirements, including solar, wind, hybrid projects, transmission lines, pooling substations, approach roads, and evacuation infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of Land & Estate documentation such as sale deeds, lease deeds, agreements to sell, MoUs, consent letters, ROW agreements, NOCs, maps, surveys, and land schedules.
* Understanding of statutory approvals, local permissions, government liaisoning, revenue department processes, forest clearance, panchayat approvals, and state renewable energy policy requirements.
* Ability to read and interpret land records, revenue maps, survey drawings, village maps, cadastral maps, GIS inputs, project layouts, and transmission alignment drawings.
* Capability to maintain land MIS, approval trackers, issue logs, risk registers, documentation repositories, and management dashboards.
* Commercial awareness on land valuation, negotiation principles, compensation structures, lease rentals, transaction cost, and budgeting for land acquisition.
* Understanding of legal, regulatory, compliance, and governance risks associated with land acquisition and estate management.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Stakeholder Management: Ability to work effectively with landowners, local communities, aggregators, government authorities, internal project teams, and senior leadership.
* Ownership and Accountability: Demonstrates high follow-through, proactive escalation, and commitment to timely land availability for project milestones.
* Negotiation and Influencing: Capable of managing sensitive discussions, building consensus, and resolving conflicts with practical and compliant solutions.
* Planning and Execution: Strong ability to track multiple workstreams, manage priorities, maintain documentation discipline, and drive closure across site and Head Office teams.

title: Executive Chef
description:
📍 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

We are looking for an experienced Executive Chef / Corporate Chef to lead our culinary function across multiple outlets.

This is a leadership role for a chef who combines strong culinary fundamentals, multi-cuisine expertise, product development, operational understanding and the ability to build systems that deliver consistency at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Product Innovation & Menu Development

• Lead new product and menu development across cuisines and formats.

• Develop, test and standardise new recipes while maintaining consistency in taste, presentation, yield and commercial viability.

• Identify emerging food trends and translate relevant trends into practical, scalable products.

• Drive periodic menu innovation and product refreshes based on customer preferences and market trends.

2. Product Quality & Consistency

• Take overall ownership of product consistency across all units.

• Establish and monitor standard recipes, preparation methods, portioning, plating and finishing standards.

• Conduct regular kitchen audits to ensure adherence to defined product and process standards.

• Identify gaps in execution and implement corrective measures.

3. Kitchen Processes & Operational Systems

• Develop and standardise kitchen SOPs, production processes and operational workflows.

• Establish efficient production and mise-en-place systems for individual outlets.

• Improve kitchen productivity, utilisation of manpower and overall operational efficiency.

• Work closely with operations teams to ensure culinary systems are practical and consistently implemented.

4. Food Costing, Yield & Commercial Understanding

• Develop and maintain recipe costing and yield standards for products.

• Monitor food cost, portion control and wastage across units.

• Work with the management and operations teams to improve product profitability without compromising quality.

• Assist in evaluating ingredients, alternatives and vendor products from both culinary and commercial perspectives.

5. Team Building, Recruitment & Training

• Participate in recruitment and selection of culinary team members, particularly at CDP and above levels.

• Build and develop a strong culinary team across outlets.

• Conduct regular training on recipes, techniques, processes, hygiene, food quality and kitchen discipline.

• Develop training systems that allow culinary standards to be replicated consistently across locations.

6. New Outlet Planning & Set-Up

• Work closely with the management and project teams during new outlet development.

• Plan kitchen layouts, equipment requirements and operational flow.

• Prepare manpower requirements and kitchen organisation plans for new units.

• Assist in production planning, inventory planning and back-of-house infrastructure.

• Ensure kitchens are designed around practical workflow, productivity, food safety and scalability.

7. Hygiene, Food Safety & Kitchen Standards

• Take responsibility for maintaining high standards of kitchen hygiene and food safety across all units.

• Ensure compliance with established hygiene, storage, handling and production protocols.

• Establish systems for monitoring and maintaining these standards consistently.

PRE-REQUISITES

• Minimum 10 years of professional culinary / food production experience.

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an Outlet Chef, Head Chef or equivalent leadership position.

• Strong hands-on understanding of multi-cuisine food production.

• In-depth technical knowledge of cooking techniques, ingredients, preparation methods and kitchen processes.

• Strong palate and ability to evaluate taste, balance, texture, consistency and presentation.

• Experience in recipe development, standardisation and product innovation.

• Strong understanding of kitchen operations, production planning, manpower deployment, inventory and food costing.

• Ability to train, mentor and build culinary teams.

• Willingness to travel across existing and new units as required.

• The candidate should be equally comfortable with culinary creativity and operational discipline.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who can think beyond an individual kitchen.

Someone who can take a food idea from concept → recipe development → trials → standardisation → costing → training → production → execution across multiple outlets.

More importantly, we are looking for someone who is passionate about building something and growing along with the company.

This is not simply a role for someone looking for the next designation. We are looking for a culinary professional who wants to take ownership, contribute ideas, build teams, create systems and evolve with a growing food business.

As the company grows, we want the person in this role to grow with it, taking on greater responsibility and becoming an integral part of the company’s culinary journey.

The role requires a chef who enjoys being on the floor, tasting food, solving operational problems, developing people and continuously improving the product.

If you believe you can build great food and build the systems that allow great food to be replicated at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance practices.
* Coordinate recruitment calendars, campaign timelines, event logistics, and competing operational priorities to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure recruitment activities deliver against agreed enrolment targets, service standards, and institutional growth objectives.

**3. Leadership, Team Management & Capability Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.
* Set clear objectives, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, student-focused, and commercially driven recruitment culture.
* Develop team capabilities through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development.
* Foster collaboration across recruitment, marketing, admissions, academic, and student support functions.
* Introduce innovative recruitment approaches, student engagement initiatives, and outreach models to enhance productivity and market penetration.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen recruitment processes.
* Oversee recruitment-related budgets, campaign expenditure, event planning, and resource allocation, as applicable.
* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Support succession planning, capability development, and the effective use of team resources to meet evolving business needs.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.
* Uphold equal opportunity, workplace health and safety (OSH), data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Ensure appropriate handling of prospective student and applicant information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), where applicable.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, partner documentation, performance reports, and operational records.
* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.
* Accuracy of recruitment data, reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
* Compliance with institutional policies, recruitment processes, and applicable regulations.
* Team productivity, target achievement, and professional development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* Significant experience in student recruitment, education management, business development, institutional partnerships, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing recruitment strategies and achieving measurable enrolment or business growth targets.
* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate institutional growth objectives into practical recruitment strategies and actionable plans.
* **Business development:**
  Strong partnership-building, networking, negotiation, and market expansion capabilities.
* **Performance management:**
  Ability to establish KPIs, analyse recruitment data, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, public speaking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to motivate teams, manage performance, develop talent, and foster a results-oriented culture.
* **Operational management:**
  Strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* **Analytical ability:**
  Proficiency in interpreting market intelligence, CRM data, conversion metrics, and performance reports.
* **Relationship management:**
  Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.
* Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.
* Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.
* Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.
* Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.

Who you are

* **Mandatory: real, hands-on ground experience.**
   8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have stood on sites, managed crews and contractors, and know how a PNG connection is built, from survey to gas-on. Desk-only or consulting backgrounds will not be considered.
* **Deep relationships across PSUs, government and utilities.**
   You have strong, active links with decision-makers in gas, power and other utility companies, PSUs and the government departments that oversee them, and you know how they evaluate, approve and buy.
* **Commercial instinct.**
   You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. You can open a door, run a meeting and follow through to a decision.
* **Equally at home on a site and in a boardroom.**
   You can win over a plumbing supervisor, and you can present calmly and crisply to an MD.
* **Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi,**
   with clear spoken and written English for leadership meetings and proposals.
* **A natural trainer and explainer.**
   You can take a non-technical crew through a new app and get them using it the same day.
* **A sharp observer.**
   You notice how work really gets done, and you can describe it clearly enough for a product team to act on.
* **Firm and fair with contractors.**
   You hold people to commitments without breaking the relationship.
* **Comfortable with data.**
   You live in dashboards and Excel, and you act on what the numbers show.
* **A builder.**
   You want to create something new, are comfortable with ambiguity, and own outcomes rather than tasks.
* **Graduate engineer**
   (mechanical, civil, chemical or petroleum preferred), or equivalent field experience.

Good to have

* Experience at a Gujarat city gas company, or with contractors who work for one.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement: tenders, empanelment and approval processes.
* Exposure to SAP in a utility (service orders, contractor billing or customer service).
* Experience rolling out a field app or digital process to a distributed, non-office workforce.
* Experience in a startup, or in a new-business role inside a larger company.
* A network of contractors, plumbers and site supervisors in Gujarat.

Location, pay and how to apply

* **Base:**
   Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
* **Travel:**
   frequent day trips to pilot sites and service centres in Gujarat (for example Surat and Bharuch), plus travel to other states for client meetings.
* **Ownership:**
   [ESOPs or equity, to be discussed].
* **Growth:**
   as the product scales, you build and lead the field and client team across utilities.

**To apply,**
 send your CV to Vivek.slaria@originbluy.com with a short note on one field rollout you led and one client you helped win: what was stuck, what you did, and what changed.

B.E. / B.Tech (Engineering) with an MBA in Operations Management (preferred).
