title: Head of Electrical Engineering
description:
**\*Purpose/Objective:**

Lead the Electrical Engineering function for Adani WTG Manufacturing with end-to-end technical ownership of electrical systems across the WTG platform. The role will drive electrical architecture, component engineering, system integration, verification & validation, grid compliance, certification, reliability improvement, localization and technology development. The incumbent will work closely with Mechanical, Loads, Controls, SCADA, Blade, Nacelle, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Project Engineering and Service teams to deliver reliable, cost-competitive and certifiable WTG platforms.

**About Business:**

**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG):**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.

**Job Purpose:**

The Lead Grid Compliance leads the development and implementation of strategies to ensure wind turbines meet regulatory requirements for grid connection, power quality, and dynamic grid support. This role oversees the design and integration of SCADA systems, focusing on real-time monitoring, control, and data acquisition to optimize turbine performance. The Lead manages testing and validation processes, including power quality assessments and grid support simulations, and prepares compliance reports for regulatory bodies. This position also addresses cybersecurity risks within SCADA systems, drives continuous improvement in grid interaction technologies, and mentors a team of engineers to enhance their expertise in grid compliance and SCADA operations.

**\***
Key Responsibilities of Role

1. WTG Electrical System Architecture

* Own the overall electrical architecture of wind turbine platforms from concept through serial production.
* Define system/sub-system requirements, technical specifications, interfaces and design criteria.
* Lead engineering of:
* Generator and generator interfaces
* Power converters
* Main and auxiliary transformers
* Pitch electrical system
* Low-voltage and medium-voltage systems
* Switchgear and protection systems
* UPS and auxiliary power systems
* Cable and harness systems
* Earthing and lightning protection interfaces
* Electrical panels and power distribution systems
* Ensure robust electrical interfaces across converter, generator, controls, transformer, switchgear and grid connection systems.

2. Generator & Power Conversion

* Provide technical leadership for generator selection, specification, integration and validation.
* Lead converter architecture, sizing and performance requirements, including thermal and electrical interfaces.
* Drive system-level optimization between generator, converter, transformer and turbine control.
* Review component design margins, losses, efficiency, temperature rise and operating envelopes.

3. Grid Integration & Compliance

* Lead WTG electrical engineering support for grid-code compliance and turbine-grid integration.
* Guide power quality, reactive power, voltage/frequency response and protection philosophy.
* Coordinate engineering inputs for electrical modelling, grid studies and compliance verification.
* Ensure electrical design supports applicable project and market-specific grid requirements.

4. Controls, SCADA & Electrical Interfaces

* Work closely with Controls and SCADA engineering teams to ensure complete integration of electrical equipment into the turbine control architecture.
* Define sensors, measurements, alarms, protections, interlocks and operational sequences.
* Lead interface management among electrical hardware, turbine controller, converter controller and SCADA.
* Support troubleshooting of turbine-level electrical and control interactions.

5. Design Verification & Validation

* Establish electrical DVP&R / verification and validation plans for components and turbine systems.
* Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and engineering sign-offs.
* Define prototype, laboratory, bench and turbine-level validation requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis for electrical failures using structured methodologies such as
  **8D, FMEA/FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis and RCA**
  .
* Drive corrective and preventive engineering actions based on field and test observations.

6. Reliability & Product Performance

* Own electrical reliability improvement across the WTG lifecycle.
* Analyse recurring failures involving converters, generators, transformers, pitch electrical systems and other electrical components.
* Drive improvements in thermal management, electrical protection, component life and system robustness.
* Develop design improvements based on testing, manufacturing and field-performance feedback.

7. Certification & Engineering Compliance

* Ensure electrical designs are compliant with applicable wind turbine certification and electrical engineering requirements.
* Coordinate engineering activities with certification bodies and external technical agencies where required.
* Maintain design documentation, calculations, specifications, compliance evidence and engineering change records.
* Support WTG type certification and platform upgrades from an electrical engineering perspective.

8. Localization & Supplier Engineering

* Drive localization and alternate-source development for critical electrical components.
* Develop technical specifications and qualification criteria for suppliers.
* Participate in supplier capability assessment, technical reviews and component qualification.
* Work with Supply Chain and Quality teams on technical closure of supplier deviations and engineering changes.
* Drive design-to-cost and value-engineering initiatives without compromising reliability or compliance.

9. Manufacturing & Service Support

* Provide engineering support for manufacturing ramp-up and serial production.
* Address electrical non-conformities and recurring manufacturing issues through permanent engineering solutions.
* Support commissioning and service teams on complex turbine electrical failures and field issues.

description:

We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The role involves managing fire safety operations, adequate staffing, equipment readiness, and responding to fire emergencies. Responsibilities include maintaining fire safety systems, conducting regular equipment checks, and overseeing training programs for safety and emergency preparedness. The position requires monitoring and reporting on safety compliance, supporting audits and inspections, and upholding business sustainability through adherence to various safety and environmental guidelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Safety & Fire**
**Operational Management And Readiness**
Manage fire safety manpower, ensuring adequate staffing and readiness for all shifts.
  
  
Attend to all rescue/fire calls during the shift within premises and site.
  
  
Ensure the fitness and readiness of fire tenders, accessories, and other firefighting equipment.
  
  
Assist seniors in the performance of various fire prevention/firefighting duties, as required.
  
  
Communicate administrative/firefighting matters to the seniors, as needed and ensure effective communication systems from the fire station are maintained.
  
  
Check and ensure all outsourced fire staff or other contracting agencies are reporting for duty as per requirement.
  
  
**Equipment And System Maintenance**
Maintain and check fire safety systems regularly to ensure efficient operations.
  
  
Conduct periodic and standard tests of all fire station equipment, appliances, and breathing apparatus sets.
  
  
Responsible for the monthly checks and quarterly maintenance of fire extinguishers as per schedule.
  
  
Oversee the refilling of fire extinguishers and maintain records of occurrences and equipment status.
  
  
Ensure periodic tests of all fire station equipment, appliances, and BA sets during shifts as per station check sheet requirements.
  
  
**Training And Campaigns**
Conduct Safety induction Training and vertigo test for new staff and workers of agencies and support in safety campaigns and participate in mock drills to prepare staff for emergency situations.
  
  
Conduct various EHS Training programs and track training data and ensure the completion of mandatory training hours as per CEA regulation.
  
  
Provide support and required information for investigation of near-miss incidents and incidents to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
  
  
Conduct awareness sessions for agency workmen to reinforce safety standards.
  
  
Track and ensure monthly safety virus campaigns to highlight and mitigate potential safety risks.
  
  
Provide support for audits and inspections- daily, weekly, monthly to maintain high safety standards and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Monitoring And Reporting**
Upload daily safety observations for the whole plant in GENSUITE.
  
  
Conduct weekly initiatives at assigned areas, prepare reports, and monitor compliance.
  
  
Ensure the display of safety signages to maintain awareness and compliance.
  
  
Manage the availability and usage of PPEs by staff and workers of agencies at the site as per service order.
  
  
Compile and report critical observations for fire safety of the entire plant.
  
  
**Business Sustainability**
Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
  
  
Conduct various audits and surveys, including night vigilance, dry grass survey, and critical area audits.
  
  
Ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.
  
  
Release and monitor Hot work permits in the plant for its compliances.
  
  
Ensure adherence to compliances as per KRONOS.
  
  
Conduct stand-down meetings and conduct trainings for Rapid Response Team (RRT) members.

All departments - Station/Plants

Audit Agencies
  
  
Contractors

**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably in Fire Safety or Chemical Engineering) or related field and mandatory Advanced/Post Diploma in Industrial Safety or Degree (BSc/MSc) in PCM; MSc. in Chemistry + Post Diploma/Advance Diploma or B.Sc. in Fire Engineering/ B.tech Fire Engineering.

8+ years of experience in fire safety management and operations within the power or heavy industry sector.

Power Generation or Energy sector

title: Trading Desk Manager - Prop Desk Operations & Risk
description:
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat · Full-time, in-office (open to candidates across India willing to relocate)

**Reports to:**
Founder / Head of Trading

**Experience:**
5+ years in F&O dealing, broker RMS, or prop desk operations

**Compensation:**
Competitive, based on experience

**About the desk**

We're scaling our proprietary quant trading desk in Ahmedabad. Our traders are active in NSE F&O at high volume, and as we grow our in-house trading team, we need a dedicated manager to own daily operations, risk, and trader coordination - so the founder can focus on strategy and the wider business.

This is a dynamic, hands-on role at the operational core of the desk. You'll be the first point of contact for every trader and the person who keeps margin, risk, and broker records in order, every single day. We're looking for someone with the proven judgment to read a situation fast and act decisively in the best interest of the company - whether that's holding the line on risk, resolving a broker dispute, or making the call under live-market pressure.

**What you'll do**

*Margin & risk*

* Allocate daily margin across traders based on strategy, performance, and limits
* Monitor intraday margin utilisation, MTM, and loss limits — and act before limits are breached
* Track exposure and concentration across the desk, and flag risks early

*Desk operations*

* Run the daily sync-up call: previous day's P&L, open positions, and the plan for the day
* Reconcile daily with the broker: contract notes, ledger, margin statements, and obligations
* Raise and resolve broker discrepancies the same day, with a clear written trail
* Keep desk records, limits, and procedures documented and current

*Trader support & escalation*

* Be the first point of contact for trader queries, platform issues, and order problems
* Resolve routine issues directly; escalate to the founder by agreed rules (loss limits, margin shortfall, broker issues)
* Enforce trading discipline and desk policies consistently

*Reporting*

* Send an end-of-day desk summary: P&L by trader, margin use, and exceptions
* Prepare a weekly performance and risk review for the founder

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in NSE F&O dealing, broker RMS (Risk Management System), or prop desk operations
* Hands-on knowledge of F&O margining: SPAN + exposure margin, peak margin rules, MTM settlement
* Experience reconciling contract notes, ledgers, and margin statements with brokers
* Strong Excel skills (pivots, lookups, daily MIS)
* A proven track record of managing live situations with sound judgment and acting in the best interest of the desk and the business
* Calm, firm judgment under live-market pressure
* Clear communication with traders and senior management
* Willing to work full-time from our Ahmedabad office

**Nice to have**

* NISM Series VII (Securities Operations & Risk Management) and/or NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives)
* Python or SQL for automating reports and risk checks
* Experience with algo, quant, or high-frequency trading desks
* Prior experience managing or coordinating a team of traders or dealers
* Gujarati or Hindi, in addition to English

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a live, high-volume F&O desk from day one
* Direct work with the founder, with real influence on how the desk is run and scaled
* A small, fast team with no layers between decisions and action
* Competitive pay based on experience

**How to apply**

Apply directly on LinkedIn, or email your CV to “hr@guru99.com” with the subject "Trading Desk Manager - Ahmedabad". Tell us your current location, notice period, and a few lines on the largest desk or RMS book you've managed.

title: Quality Management Executive
description:
Job Description – Head, Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Company: Eastface Packaging – A Division of Sahitya Mudranalaya Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Department: Quality

Designation: Head – Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Reporting To: Plant Head / Management

Industry: Printing & Packaging – Folding Cartons / Mono Cartons

Experience - Minimum 2 - 3 years

**Salary - 40-45k per month

For applications send cv on codasyncs.hrbp1@gmail.com with a request to fix an appointment**

Role Purpose

The QMS Head will be responsible for developing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System at Eastface Packaging.

The role will ensure that manufacturing operations, documentation, quality controls, hygiene systems, traceability, customer requirements, and regulatory processes comply with applicable standards including ISO, BRCGS Packaging Materials, GMP, FSC and customer-specific requirements.

The QMS Head will act as the key owner of quality-system compliance and will coordinate closely with Production, Quality Control, Stores, Purchase, Maintenance, HR, Prepress and senior management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Management System

\* Develop, implement and maintain the company’s Quality Management System.

\* Establish and maintain SOPs, work instructions, policies, formats, registers and quality records.

\* Ensure effective document control and revision control across departments.

\* Ensure all processes are performed according to approved procedures and specifications.

\* Periodically review the effectiveness of the QMS and recommend improvements.

\* Ensure proper implementation of change-control procedures.

2. BRCGS & Certification Management

\* Lead implementation and maintenance of BRCGS Packaging Materials certification requirements.

\* Ensure continuous readiness for announced and unannounced audits.

\* Coordinate ISO, BRCGS, FSC and other certification audits.

\* Conduct regular gap assessments against applicable certification standards.

\* Ensure corrective actions arising from certification audits are completed within defined timelines.

\* Maintain records and evidence required for certification and surveillance audits.

3. Internal Audits

\* Develop the annual internal-audit schedule.

\* Conduct and coordinate internal audits across all departments.

\* Identify non-conformities, observations and opportunities for improvement.

\* Issue audit reports and monitor corrective and preventive actions.

\* Verify effectiveness of CAPA implementation.

\* Escalate recurring or critical non-conformities to management.

4. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis

\* Manage the company’s Corrective and Preventive Action system.

\* Lead root-cause analysis for:

\* Customer complaints

\* Internal quality failures

\* Audit non-conformities

\* Process deviations

\* Repeated production defects

\* Use structured problem-solving techniques such as:

\* 5 Why Analysis

\* Fishbone / Ishikawa Analysis

\* Pareto Analysis

\* Risk Assessment

\* Track CAPA closure and verify effectiveness.

5. Customer Complaints & Quality Requirements

\* Coordinate investigation of customer quality complaints.

\* Prepare detailed root-cause analysis and CAPA reports for customers.

\* Monitor recurring complaints and implement preventive measures.

\* Understand and maintain customer-specific quality requirements.

\* Participate in customer audits and technical discussions where required.

\* Maintain complaint trends and periodically present them to management.

6. GMP, Hygiene & Housekeeping

Ensure implementation of GMP and hygiene standards throughout the manufacturing facility, including:

\* Personnel hygiene

\* Factory housekeeping

\* Pest-control systems

\* Cleaning schedules

\* Waste management

\* Glass and brittle-plastic controls

\* Chemical controls

\* Foreign-body prevention

\* Material segregation

\* Storage practices

\* Employee movement and access controls

Ensure hygiene and food-safety requirements are implemented wherever applicable.

7. Risk Management

\* Conduct process and product risk assessments.

\* Identify quality, safety and contamination risks within manufacturing operations.

\* Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans.

\* Ensure preventive controls are established for critical processes.

\* Periodically reassess risks based on process changes, customer complaints and audit findings.

8. Traceability & Product Recall Systems

\* Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability of:

\* Raw materials

\* Printing inks and coatings

\* Consumables

\* Work-in-process materials

\* Finished goods

\* Conduct periodic mock traceability / recall exercises.

\* Ensure traceability can be demonstrated within required timelines during audits.

\* Maintain batch identification and production records.

10. Documentation & Record Control

Maintain and control QMS documentation including:

\* Quality Manual

\* SOPs

\* Work Instructions

\* Policies

\* Process Flow Charts

\* Quality Formats

\* Audit Records

\* Inspection Records

\* Training Records

\* Calibration Records

\* Maintenance Records

\* Pest-Control Records

\* Cleaning Records

\* CAPA Records

\* Complaint Records

\* Supplier Assessments

\* Risk Assessments

Ensure obsolete documents are withdrawn and only current approved versions are available for use.

11. Training & Quality Culture

\* Identify quality-system training requirements across departments.

\* Conduct induction and periodic QMS/GMP training.

\* Train employees on relevant SOPs and work instructions.

\* Conduct awareness programs related to:

\* GMP

\* Hygiene

\* Food safety

\* Quality standards

\* BRCGS requirements

\* Customer requirements

\* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.

12. Management Review

\* Prepare data for periodic Management Review Meetings.

\* Present key quality metrics including:

\* Customer complaints

\* Internal rejection

\* CAPA status

\* Audit findings

\* Supplier quality

\* Customer quality performance

\* Training compliance

\* Quality objectives

\* Certification status

\* Follow up on actions agreed during management reviews.

Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

Performance of the QMS Head will be measured through:

\* Successful completion of BRCGS / ISO and customer audits.

\* Number and severity of audit non-conformities.

\* Timely closure of CAPAs.

\* Reduction in repeat customer complaints.

\* Internal audit compliance.

\* Documentation compliance.

\* GMP and hygiene audit scores.

\* Traceability-test performance.

\* Training completion rate.

\* Reduction in recurring quality-system failures.

\* Supplier quality performance.

\* Closure of customer complaints within agreed timelines.

Qualification

Preferred Qualification:

\* B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc. / M.Sc. / Diploma in Printing, Packaging, Engineering, Chemistry, Food Technology, Quality Management or a related discipline.

Additional certifications in the following will be preferred:

\* BRCGS Packaging Materials

\* ISO 9001

\* Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor

\* GMP

\* HACCP / Food Safety

\* FSC Chain of Custody

Experience

Preferred: 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Management Systems.

At least 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership role will be preferred.

Candidates with hands-on experience in BRCGS, ISO systems, audits, CAPA, documentation control, customer quality management and continuous improvement will be given preference.

Technical Knowledge Required

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of:

\* BRCGS Packaging Materials

\* ISO Quality Management Systems

\* GMP

\* CAPA

\* Root Cause Analysis

\* Internal Auditing

\* Risk Assessment

\* Document Control

\* Supplier Quality

\* Customer Complaint Management

\* Traceability

\* Product Recall

\* Change Control

\* Calibration Systems

\* Hygiene Management

\* Pest Control

\* Quality KPIs

Knowledge of printing and folding-carton manufacturing processes will be an added advantage.

Key Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

\* Strong ownership of quality systems

\* High attention to detail

\* Strong documentation discipline

\* Analytical and structured problem-solving ability

\* Ability to lead audits confidently

\* Ability to coordinate across multiple departments

\* Strong communication skills

\* Ability to train and influence shop-floor teams

\* Strong follow-up and closure orientation

\* Ability to work directly with senior management and customer quality teams

**Salary - 40-45k per month

For applications send cv on codasyncs.hrbp1@gmail.com with a request to fix an appointment**

Role Expectation

The QMS Head will be expected to create a system-driven quality culture rather than an audit-driven quality culture, ensuring that compliance and quality requirements become part of everyday manufacturing operations.

The individual should be capable of independently owning the QMS function and ensuring that Eastface Packaging remains continuously prepared for BRCGS, ISO, customer and regulatory audits while supporting the company’s growth and quality objectives.

title: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, in the office · Monday to Saturday, Australian hours · ₹15 LPA plus bonus**

Applications close Sunday 1 November 2026.

**FROM PRIYANK, THE FOUNDER**

Before I became a broker, I worked for the lenders: Lending Manager at Bank of Melbourne and Commercial Credit Analyst at La Trobe Financial. I started Prevail Finance in 2017. Today I meet our clients and structure their loans. I need one person I can hand every deal to: someone who knows Australian credit inside out, still works files themselves, and wants to build the team that gets every loan to settlement without me chasing it.

**HOW A DEAL MOVES HERE**

1. I meet the client, set the strategy and structure, and hand the deal to you with my notes.
2. You assess it: documents, income, serviceability and lender policy. You write the credit proposal, with lender options and risks, and we workshop it together.
3. I confirm the recommendation with the client. All credit advice stays with me as the licence holder.
4. You and your team package the file, lodge it through ApplyOnline, and take it through valuation, conditions, approval and loan documents to settlement.
5. Your team keeps the client updated at every step.

**WHAT YOU’RE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

Above all, one result: every loan we write settles on time, with no errors. You will:

* assess and write up the complex files yourself: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, business and commercial loans
* check your team’s work before anything reaches a lender: documents, servicing inputs, and the identity, anti-money-laundering and responsible lending checks
* keep SalesTrekker current, so every file has an owner, a next step and a date
* work with lenders and their BDMs on policy, pricing, conditions and valuations
* train and lead the loans team, and help choose its next hire

You report to me, and to a General Manager once we appoint one.

**A DAY IN THE ROLE**

You start early, on Australian hours. First the pipeline: which files need you, which settlements are close, what’s at risk. Then your own files: a new deal from me to assess, a credit proposal to finish, a condition to clear. Through the day you review your team’s files before lodgement, call BDMs, and unblock whatever is stuck. Each week you run the pipeline review. You finish in the afternoon IST, with every client updated and tomorrow’s priorities set.

**WHY THE RIGHT PERSON WILL WANT THIS**

* Real deals, not volume: business owners buying premises, commercial property, construction and business purchases, from $400k to $10M+.
* You learn from me. I’ve assessed these loans at a bank and at a non-bank lender, and I still develop property myself.
* You’re our first credit leader. You set the standards everyone after you works to.
* Premium pay, published: ₹15 LPA plus bonus.
* Your authority is in writing from day one. By day 90 you run the pipeline and I’ve stopped chasing files.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 5+ years assessing or processing Australian loans for brokers or lenders, onshore or offshore, from application to settlement
* Experience with self-employed borrowers trading through companies and trusts: financials, tax returns, add-backs
* Current hands-on work: you still work files yourself, not only supervise
* Experience leading, training or checking other people’s work
* A degree in commerce, accounting, finance or banking
* Clear spoken and written English: you’ll talk to Australian lenders every day

Even better: commercial, business, construction or development loans. Mercury, Infynity, BrokerEngine or SalesTrekker.

Not for you if: you’ve only worked on US or UK mortgages, or you’ve moved into management and no longer work files yourself.

**WHERE AND WHEN**

Our Gandhinagar office. You live within about 30 km, or relocate before you start. Monday to Saturday, on Australian hours: an early start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email priyank@prevailfinance.com.au with your CV, current location and notice period, and a link to one video of up to five minutes answering:

1. An Australian loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, which you personally turned around: the lender, what was wrong, what you did, and what happened.
2. A time you held a colleague to a standard they weren’t meeting: what you said, and what happened next.
3. One thing in this ad you’d do differently, and why.

Record it on your phone, without a script. Send it as a Google Drive, unlisted YouTube or Loom link that anyone can open.

Subject line: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – your name

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Every applicant gets a reply. Shortlisted applicants have a 60-minute interview with me, then a working session on a real past file with every client detail removed. On appointment: a written role agreement, a police check, and a three-month window to show the role works, for both sides. Every application is assessed on the same standard, and nothing without a bearing on the work counts.

title: Chief Manager Safety
description:
**Job Description**

**Company:**
Anup Engineering Limited

**Position:**
Safety Lead

**Location:**
Odhav, Ahmedabad

**Experience:**
15+ Years

**Industry:**
Heavy Engineering / Fabrication / Process Equipment Manufacturing

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Safety Lead to oversee health, safety, and environmental (HSE) activities at our manufacturing facility. The role involves ensuring statutory compliance, implementing safety procedures, managing workplace hazards, conducting audits and training, and promoting a strong safety culture across fabrication and manufacturing operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HSE Legal & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and statutory regulations.
* Liaise with the Pollution Control Board and other relevant government authorities.
* Coordinate internal and external safety audits, including ISO 45001/OHSAS 18001 and ISO 14001 requirements.

**2. Hazard Identification & Risk Management**

* Conduct hazard analysis, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and risk assessments for manufacturing and fabrication activities.
* Identify unsafe conditions and practices through regular workplace inspections and recommend corrective actions.
* Investigate accidents, incidents, and near misses, maintain records, and implement preventive measures.
* Develop and implement safety procedures to mitigate risks associated with fabrication and heavy engineering operations.

**3. Workplace Safety & Permit Management**

* Implement and monitor the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system for hot work, work at height, lifting operations, excavation, and confined-space activities.
* Inspect PPE, lifting tools and tackles, scaffolding, electrical equipment, and other safety-critical equipment.
* Ensure the availability and proper use of PPE, first-aid facilities, fire protection equipment, and emergency response systems.
* Monitor safe working practices across shop-floor manufacturing, fabrication, and material-handling operations.

**4. Training & Safety Awareness**

* Conduct EHS induction training, toolbox talks, mock drills, and regular safety awareness programmes.
* Organize safety campaigns and events such as National Safety Day, Fire Service Day, and World Environment Day.
* Drive employee participation in safety initiatives, including near-miss reporting and other safety improvement programmes.

**5. Reporting & Safety Governance**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly safety observation reports, accident statistics, and compliance reports.
* Conduct monthly safety committee meetings and track corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor safety performance indicators and recommend improvements to reduce workplace incidents.

**6. Client Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with clients, auditors, contractors, and statutory authorities on safety-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver safety presentations, audit reports, and compliance updates.
* Communicate safety requirements effectively to employees, contractors, and management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification in Industrial Safety, such as PDIS/ADIS, as applicable to statutory requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 15+ years of experience in HSE/Safety, preferably in heavy engineering, pressure vessel manufacturing, fabrication, or process equipment industries.
* Strong understanding of fabrication processes and associated workplace hazards.
* Hands-on experience in risk assessment, accident investigation, PTW systems, safety audits, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in managing shop-floor safety, contractor safety, and emergency preparedness.
* Strong client-handling, presentation, report-writing, and English communication skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A proactive safety professional with strong leadership skills, the ability to influence shop-floor teams, and proven experience in implementing safety standards within a heavy engineering or fabrication manufacturing environment.

title: Field Operations Manager
description:
Go-Grab is building the next generation of smart vending and convenience retail in India. We operate smart vending machines across leading colleges and high-footfall locations, bringing snacks, beverages and everyday essentials closer to consumers through technology-driven retail.

As we continue expanding across cities and campuses, we are looking for a Field Operations Manager to take ownership of our operations across a city/cluster.

About the Role

As a
**Field Operations Manager**
, you will be responsible for managing Go-Grab's day-to-day operations across multiple locations within an assigned city.

Your primary focus will be to ensure our vending machines remain operational, well-stocked and efficiently managed. This is a hands-on role involving field team coordination, inventory management, machine performance, vendor management and on-ground problem-solving.

You will work closely with refillers, technicians, college stakeholders and Go-Grab's central teams to ensure smooth operations and deliver a consistent customer experience.

What You'll Do

* Manage day-to-day operations across Go-Grab's vending machines in the assigned city.
* Ensure high machine uptime, product availability and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate and supervise refillers, technicians and other on-ground teams.
* Plan and monitor daily refilling, replenishment and inventory movement.
* Track machine-level performance and identify locations requiring attention.
* Investigate operational issues, identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure machines are clean, functional, properly maintained and customer-ready.
* Monitor stock availability, expiry, inventory discrepancies and product movement.
* Coordinate with warehouse and supply teams to ensure timely replenishment.

What We're Looking For

* **2–4 years of experience**
  in field operations, operations management, logistics, supply chain, retail or a similar role.
* Experience coordinating operations across multiple locations or sites.
* Experience managing frontline teams, vendors, technicians or field staff.
* Strong problem-solving, coordination and execution skills.
* Ability to identify root causes and take corrective action independently.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfortable using operational data and reports to track performance.
* Willingness to travel regularly across locations within the assigned city.
* A strong sense of ownership, accountability and urgency.
* Experience in quick commerce, logistics, FMCG distribution, retail, food and beverage, or facility management is a plus.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

We're looking for someone who is
**hands-on, resourceful, street-smart and comfortable taking ownership**
.

This is not a desk-only role. You'll regularly coordinate with on-ground teams, visit campuses, inspect machines, investigate stock discrepancies, resolve operational issues and ensure problems are fixed rather than simply reported.

You'll be expected to take initiative, manage multiple priorities and ensure daily operations run smoothly across your assigned locations.

If you enjoy solving real-world problems, coordinating people and getting things done in a fast-paced startup environment, we'd love to hear from you.

**Site Delivery & Front Management**

* Own delivery of the site against the baseline — cost, schedule, quality and safety — and the recovery plan when it slips.
* Integrate civil, mechanical, electrical, commissioning and enabling works into one sequenced, de-conflicted front.

**Drive contractor performance and productivity;**

* hold them to programmed, manpower and method commitments.

**Safety, Quality & Statutory Ownership On The Ground**

* Be visibly, personally accountable for zero harm — set the tone, walk the site, and back every stop-work made for the right reason.

* Ensure statutory, environmental and labor compliance is live on site — permits, consents, hold-points and conditions are met before and during work.

**Cost, Commercial & Resource Control**

* Own site cost and productivity — manpower, plant, material and cash deployed for output, not just activity.
* Govern measurement, billing and certification with the Project Controller so paid work equals built work.

**Stakeholder, Land & Community Peace**

* Own escalation and resolution of land, ROW, R&R and statutory blockers that threaten the front, working HO and authorities together.

18+ years in site execution of large infrastructure / EPC projects, including 6+ years as Site / Project Manager owning a full project front

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Together, everything is possible

The Manager of Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery is a hands-on practitioner and team lead who drives process discovery and improvement initiatives across assigned GBS FnA towers. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role owns the end-to-end execution of Six Sigma projects, facilitates process discovery workshops, produces high-quality process documentation, and coaches Analysts. The Manager bridges strategic direction with operational delivery, ensuring GBS towers continuously evolve toward leaner, more efficient models.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Process Discovery & Improvement Execution**

* Lead full-cycle DMAIC projects for assigned GBS towers (ATR, S2P, RTR, Commercial Ops, SCM), from charter definition through Control phase.
* Facilitate SIPOC, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Swimlane, and Process Flow mapping workshops with tower SMEs and operations teams.
* Document current-state (as-is) processes and develop future-state (to-be) blueprints with gap analysis and improvement recommendations.
* Apply Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, FMEA, Root Cause Analysis) to identify and eliminate waste across transactional processes.
* Build and maintain the GBS process library (SOP-level documentation) in collaboration with tower leads.

**Data Analysis & Performance Measurement**

* Collect and analyze process performance data using statistical methods (control charts, Pareto analysis, Fishbone, hypothesis testing).
* Build and maintain KPI dashboards to track process health, improvement adoption, and project benefits realization.
* Partner with GBS Data & Analytics teams to leverage process mining tools and ERP data for baseline measurement.

**Team Leadership & Analyst Development**

* Supervise and develop 2–4 CI Analysts; assign workstreams, review deliverables, and provide structured coaching.
* Guide Analysts through process mapping assignments and quality-check documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Support Analyst Yellow Belt and Green Belt certification journeys through project guidance and knowledge transfer.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Prepare and present project updates, workshop findings, and improvement proposals to Senior Manager and tower leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or Supply Chain.
* Certified Six Sigma Green Belt (ASQ, IASSC, or equivalent) – mandatory.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in process improvement, operations, or business analysis.
* Minimum 2–3 years in a GBS, Shared Services, SSC, or BPO environment.
* Hands-on experience facilitating VSM, SIPOC, and Process Mapping sessions.
* Proficiency in process documentation tools (Visio, Lucidchart, ARIS, Signavio, or Bizagi).
* Strong data analysis skills; working knowledge of Minitab, Excel (advanced), or similar tools.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Six Sigma Black Belt certification or active pursuit.
* Exposure to process mining tools (Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).
* Experience with ERP platforms (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) in an ATR or AP context.
* Lean certification or Kaizen facilitation experience.
* Experience in FMCG, CPG, or Kraft Heinz GBS environment.

**COMPETENCIES & BEHAVIORS**

* Strong facilitation skills – ability to lead structured workshops with diverse, cross-functional participants.
* Analytical mindset with a practical, results-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate process complexity into simple documentation.

title: Registrar | Reputed University at Ahmedabad
description:
**Position Summary**

The Registrar serves as the principal administrative officer responsible for ensuring the effective delivery of all academic administration functions, governance support, student records management, and compliance with regulatory and institutional policies. The Registrar will act as a key liaison between academic leadership, faculty, students, and external stakeholders, ensuring continuity, integrity, and efficiency of academic and administrative processes within the Institute.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Academic Administration**

* Oversee all facets of academic administration, including the scheduling and coordination of academic calendars, examinations, course registrations, grading processes, and commencement ceremonies.
* Ensure accurate and secure maintenance of all student academic records, transcripts,
* certificates, and evaluations.
* Work closely with Deans, program directors, and faculty to align administrative support with academic goals and quality standards.

**2. Governance and Compliance**

* Support statutory and governing bodies (such as Academic Council, Board of Studies, and other committees) by preparing agendas, minutes, follow-ups, and ensuring compliance with policies and regulations.
* Ensure the Institute’s compliance with relevant higher education regulations, accreditation standards, and internal governance frameworks.

**3. Student Services & Records**

* Supervise student admissions procedures, enrolment documentation, academic transcripts, and records integrity.
* Serve as the custodian of institutional academic data and ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and accessibility per institutional policies.

**4. Policy Development & Implementation**

* Lead the development, review, and implementation of academic and administrative policies and standard operating procedures related to academic affairs, examinations, grading, and records management.
* Recommend improvements to streamline processes and enhance administrative efficiency.

**5. Institutional Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a key point of contact between the Vice-Chancellor’s office, academic leadership, faculty, students, and external regulatory bodies.
* Facilitate cross-departmental coordination to support institutional priorities, special initiatives and academic events.

**6. Strategic Planning & Reporting**

* Contribute to institutional strategic planning, especially on academic policies, student success initiatives, and process optimisation.
* Prepare periodic reports on academic administration metrics, compliance status, and operational enhancements for senior leadership review.

**7. Leadership & Staff Management**

* Lead the Registrar’s Office team and provide mentoring, performance oversight, and professional development support.
* Foster a culture of operational excellence, collaboration, and service orientation within the administrative functions.

**Competencies & Skills**

* Excellent strategic and operational planning capabilities.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* High integrity, confidentiality, and commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in academic information systems and data management platforms.
* Leadership ability to build collaborative administrative teams and drive institutional initiatives.

title: Deputy General Manager - Dozer Push Operations
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Lead - Dozer Push Maintenance is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and repair of dozer equipment used in push operations within the mine. This role ensures that all maintenance activities are conducted efficiently and safely. The Lead coordinates with the maintenance team, operators, and mine management to ensure dozers are kept in optimal working condition, minimizing downtime and maximizing productivity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead - Dozer Push Maintenance - Coal Mining**
**Maintenance Planning And Scheduling**
Develop and implement a comprehensive preventive maintenance schedule for all dozer equipment to ensure reliability and longevity.
  
  
Ensure all maintenance tasks are performed according to schedule, preventing equipment failures and operational disruptions.
  
  
Coordinate with dozer operators and maintenance technicians to schedule repairs promptly, minimizing downtime and maintaining operational efficiency.
  
  
Prioritize maintenance tasks based on equipment condition and operational requirements, ensuring critical equipment is always operational.
  
  
Manage the inventory of spare parts, tools, and maintenance supplies, ensuring their availability for all maintenance activities.
  
  
Place orders for parts and supplies as needed, maintaining optimal inventory levels to support continuous operations.
  
  
**Safety And Compliance**
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with the Coal Mines Regulation of 2017 and other relevant safety standards and protocols.
  
  
Conduct regular safety audits and inspections of maintenance activities and equipment, addressing any non-compliance issues promptly.
  
  
Provide ongoing safety training and guidance to the maintenance team, ensuring adherence to safe work practices and the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  
  
Participate in safety meetings, drills, and training sessions to stay updated on the latest safety practices and regulations.
  
  
Maintain accurate and detailed records of all maintenance activities, including completed tasks, parts used, and any issues encountered.
  
  
Prepare and submit required reports and documentation to regulatory bodies and mine management as mandated by regulations.
  
  
**Supervising Maintenance Personnel**
Lead and supervise a team of maintenance technicians, providing clear instructions, support, and guidance to ensure efficient workflow and high-quality work.
  
  
Conduct regular team meetings to review work progress, address challenges, share best practices, and reinforce safety protocols.
  
  
Monitor and evaluate the performance of maintenance staff, providing constructive feedback and identifying training needs to improve skills and productivity.
  
  
Foster a culture of safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement within the maintenance team, encouraging proactive problem-solving and innovation.
  
  
Develop and manage work schedules for the maintenance team, ensuring adequate coverage for all shifts, maintenance tasks, and projects.
  
  
**Troubleshooting And Problem Resolution**
Diagnose mechanical and technical issues with dozer equipment, developing and implementing effective repair solutions to minimize downtime.
  
  
Coordinate with equipment manufacturers and external specialists for complex repairs and technical support, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
  
  
Identify recurring equipment issues and implement strategies to address root causes, improving equipment reliability and reducing maintenance costs.
  
  
Stay updated on the latest advancements in dozer technology and maintenance practices, incorporating best practices into maintenance operations.
  
  
**Communication And Collaboration**
Work closely with dozer operators and mine management to understand operational needs and adjust maintenance activities accordingly.
  
  
Communicate any significant maintenance issues or equipment downtime to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency and prompt resolution.
  
  
Prepare detailed reports on maintenance activities, equipment status, and any issues encountered, providing insights and recommendations to mine management.
  
  
Maintain accurate records of all maintenance tasks, equipment conditions, and repairs conducted, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

HODs
  
  
Employees
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
DGMS
  
  
Forest Department
  
  
Environment
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mining Engineering
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
12-15 years

title: Lead - FQA
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Power Limited (APL):**
Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role is responsible to uphold and enhance the quality and integrity of mechanical components and systems through rigorous inspection and testing procedures. This includes coordinating for site inspections, conducting tests, overseeing boiler and pressure part surveys, and managing welder qualifications. The role also involves preparing and reviewing quality assurance plans and field quality plans, as well as leading quality training sessions to ensure high standards of workmanship and engineering practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Quality Assurance and Inspection:**

* Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards.
* Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares.
* Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries.
* Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures.
* Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity.
* Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc.
* Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification).
* Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment.

**Quality Control And Testing**

* Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records.
* Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages.
* Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents.
* Operational Excellence and Compliance:
* Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system.
* Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes.

**Resource Management, Training, And Innovation**

* Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning.
* Provide innovative ideas and recommendations.
* Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site.
* Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works.

**Business Sustainability**

* Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
* Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.
* Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments.
* Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm.
* Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies.

**Digitization And Automation**

* Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency.
* Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy.
* Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
* Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Maintenance Mechanical
* Operations & Maintenance
* Techno Commercial

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Agencies and contractors

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
6+ years of experience in quality assurance/control, with a significant portion in a leadership role within the power sector or related heavy industries.
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

title: Head OT - Cyber Security
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Head OT Cybersecurity is responsible for overseeing and leading the organization’s operational technology (OT) cybersecurity strategy, ensuring the security and integrity of critical infrastructure, industrial control systems (ICS), and operational environments. This senior leadership role will drive the development, implementation, and maintenance of OT cybersecurity policies, standards, and practices to protect OT assets from cyber threats. The Head OT Cybersecurity will also oversee incident response, risk management, and compliance efforts while collaborating with cross-functional teams to secure the organization’s OT environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Head OT Cybersecurity**
**OT Cybersecurity Strategy Development**
Lead the development and execution of the organization’s OT cybersecurity strategy, ensuring alignment with overall cybersecurity and business goals.
  
  
Establish a comprehensive OT cybersecurity framework that includes policies, procedures, and controls to safeguard critical infrastructure.
  
  
Continuously monitor industry trends, emerging threats, and regulatory changes to adapt and evolve OT cybersecurity strategies.
  
  
**Risk Management And Vulnerability Assessment**
Oversee risk assessments, vulnerability management, and threat modeling for OT systems, ensuring that all risks are properly identified, analyzed, and mitigated.
  
  
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans based on vulnerability assessments and threat intelligence specific to OT systems.
  
  
Monitor OT system configurations and identify opportunities to strengthen security postures, reducing exposure to cyber threats.
  
  
**Incident Response And Recovery**
Lead OT cybersecurity incident response efforts, coordinating detection, containment, investigation, and recovery from OT-related security incidents and breaches.
  
  
Develop and implement incident response plans tailored to OT environments, addressing the unique characteristics of industrial control systems.
  
  
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to investigate and resolve cybersecurity incidents, ensuring minimal impact on operations.
  
  
**Compliance And Regulatory Oversight**
Ensure OT cybersecurity policies and practices comply with relevant industry standards, regulations, and frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-82, IEC 62443, NERC CIP, GDPR).
  
  
Lead efforts to maintain OT cybersecurity compliance during audits, assessments, and inspections.
  
  
Stay up to date with industry regulatory requirements and ensure timely adaptation of OT cybersecurity practices.
  
  
**Security Architecture And Technology Management**
Design, implement, and oversee the deployment of security architecture for OT systems, including network segmentation, firewalls, access control, and endpoint security.
  
  
Work closely with the IT department to integrate OT cybersecurity measures with broader enterprise security systems.
  
  
Evaluate, recommend, and deploy new security technologies to enhance the security posture of OT environments, such as intrusion detection systems (IDS) and security information and event management (SIEM) systems.
  
  
**Collaboration With Cross-Functional Teams**
Collaborate with IT, operations, engineering, legal, compliance, and executive leadership to ensure OT cybersecurity initiatives align with organizational priorities.
  
  
Engage with external partners, including third-party vendors and regulatory bodies, to maintain the security and compliance of OT systems.
  
  
Ensure the secure integration of third-party OT devices and systems into the organization’s environment.
  
  
**Leadership And Team Management**
Lead and mentor a team of cybersecurity professionals focused on OT, ensuring high performance and professional development.
  
  
Manage OT cybersecurity staff, setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback, and ensuring alignment with the broader cybersecurity team.
  
  
Build a culture of security awareness within the OT domain, ensuring all stakeholders understand the importance of cybersecurity.
  
  
**Training And Awareness**
Develop and implement training programs to raise cybersecurity awareness among OT personnel, ensuring they understand their role in maintaining security.
  
  
Conduct regular OT cybersecurity drills and exercises to prepare staff for potential cybersecurity incidents.
  
  
Provide guidance and support to OT teams in applying security best practices to operational processes.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement And Innovation**
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by reviewing OT security incidents, analyzing root causes, and implementing improvements to prevent future occurrences.
  
  
Stay abreast of the latest trends and technologies in OT cybersecurity and integrate cutting-edge tools to enhance defense capabilities.
  
  
Lead efforts to drive innovation and enhance the cybersecurity posture of the OT environment across the organization.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Executive Leadership
  
  
Department Heads
  
  
Legal and Compliance Teams
  
  
OT Operations Team
  
  
System Administrators and Operations
  
  
Engineering and Maintenance Teams
  
  
Procurement and Vendor Management Team
  
  
Facilities Management
  
  
Training Team
  
  
Risk Management Team
  
  
Internal Auditors
  
  
IT Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Regulatory Bodies
  
  
Industrial Control System (ICS) Vendors
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
Legal Advisors
  
  
Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs)
  
  
Compliance and Certification Bodies
  
  
Industry Associations
  
  
Government Agencies
  
  
Consultants
  
  
Incident Response Service Providers
  
  
Third-Party OT Solution Providers
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Advanced certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC GICSP, IEC62443 or other OT-specific security certifications (e.g., Certified SCADA Security Architect) are highly desirable.
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
15+ years of overall experience , with a focus on securing operational technology or industrial control systems.
  
  
At least 5 years in a senior leadership or management role within OT cybersecurity.

title: Interior Site Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and experienced Site Manager to oversee daily site operations, coordinate with contractors and vendors, monitor project progress, and ensure that all work is completed according to approved designs, quality standards, safety guidelines, and project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. Site Supervision: Manage daily site activities and ensure work is carried out according to approved drawings, designs, and specifications.

2. Project Coordination: Coordinate with architects, interior designers, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

3. Workforce Management: Supervise site workers, contractors, and subcontractors and allocate tasks according to project requirements.

4. Quality Control: Ensure the quality of materials, workmanship, finishing, and installation meets company standards.

5. Project Timeline: Monitor daily progress and ensure that project milestones and deadlines are achieved.

6. Material Management: Coordinate material procurement, delivery, storage, and usage to avoid shortages or wastage.

7. Site Inspection: Conduct regular site inspections to identify issues and ensure corrective actions are taken promptly.

8. Safety Compliance: Ensure workers follow applicable safety procedures and maintain a clean and organized worksite.

9. Reporting: Prepare daily or weekly progress reports, maintain site records, and update management about project status.

10. Problem-Solving: Identify and resolve on-site challenges, delays, and coordination issues efficiently.

11. Budget Monitoring: Monitor material consumption, labour costs, and site expenses to help control project costs.

12. Client Coordination: Provide project updates and coordinate site visits with clients whenever required.

13. Final Handover: Ensure snagging, finishing work, defect rectification, and final site handover are completed properly.

Required Qualifications

\* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Interior Design, or a related field.

\* Relevant experience in site supervision, construction, or interior fit-out projects.

\* Knowledge of site execution, construction materials, drawings, and finishing work.

\* Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

\* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet project deadlines.

\* Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and project management tools is an advantage.

Key Skills

\* Site and project management

\* Team leadership

\* Vendor and contractor coordination

\* Time management

\* Quality control

\* Material and cost management

\* Communication and reporting

\* Problem-solving and decision-making

Performance Expectations

The Site Manager will be responsible for ensuring timely project completion, maintaining quality standards, minimizing material wastage, coordinating site teams effectively, and achieving successful project handovers.

title: Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing)
description:
**Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing)**

*Build the operating backbone of a U.S. staffing company’s India business. Ahmedabad. Reporting to the CEO.*

**Company:**
STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited (STCPL)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat. On-site while the office is established and through the first 90 days; hybrid thereafter

**Type:**
Full-time. Must be able to start within 30 days of offer

**Reports to:**
Founder and CEO (U.S.)

**Manages:**
People and Operations Specialist (U.S. staffing operations); HR, Payroll and Compliance Specialist (India, planned hire); the Business Operations function as it grows

**Hours:**
Staggered India schedule, typically 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, with consistent overlap with U.S. morning hours and flexibility for local business needs

**About STEPS Talent**

STEPS Talent is a U.S. enterprise technology staffing company with a growing India company, STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited. We place ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity and Software Engineering professionals with enterprise clients in the United States and India. We are establishing Ahmedabad as our permanent India headquarters and hiring the person who will run it.

**The role**

This is a founding operator role. You will not inherit a finished system. You will build one.

This is not an HR Manager, Finance Manager or administrative role. It is a hands-on business operator who knows how a staffing company runs behind the scenes.

**You own India business and financial operations end to end:**
controls, monthly close, management reporting, intercompany billing with the U.S., HR and payroll oversight, statutory compliance, and the relationships with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers. You set up the Ahmedabad office and lead key corporate and banking projects. You build the Business Operations team under you. And you work directly with the Founder and CEO, with no layers in between.

**What you will build in year one**

* A finance and controls function that U.S. leadership can trust without checking the work twice: approval workflows, segregation of duties, auditable records
* The Ahmedabad office: premises, vendors, infrastructure, people
* A steady working rhythm with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers: clear handoffs, complete documentation, deadlines met without reminders
* HR, payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, Professional Tax) run by a specialist you hire and manage
* Oversight of staffing back-office operations: consultant onboarding, timesheets, billing and client portals
* The reporting rhythm: one monthly view of cash, billing, payroll, compliance and open issues
* The systems backbone across Zoho Books, Tally, HRMS and our staffing platforms

**What good looks like at 90 days**

* Monthly close, reporting and compliance running on schedule without CEO intervention
* The Ahmedabad office and professional relationships operating with clear ownership
* The first management dashboard live, and a prioritized systems plan for the next two quarters

**Who does well here**

* 10+ years in business operations, ideally IT staffing or professional services, with hands-on ownership of India finance operations: monthly close, reconciliations, vendor payments, payroll controls, management reporting
* Has worked directly with Chartered Accountants, tax professionals and payroll providers, and keeps ownership inside the company
* Reads a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow and turns them into management action
* 5+ years managing people; working knowledge of Indian HR, payroll and employment compliance
* Working knowledge of U.S. staffing back-office operations: consultant lifecycle, W-2 and C2C, timesheets, client billing
* Has built processes, controls and reporting in a growing company and been personally accountable for the result. Been there, done that
* A problem-solver who owns outcomes: resolves issues at their level, escalates with options rather than questions, and does not need the CEO to close every open item
* Clear writer and speaker; discreet; comfortable working directly with U.S. leadership

**Preferred:**
Zoho Books, Zoho People, Tally, QuickBooks or comparable systems; SAP Fieldglass, SAP Ariba or similar MSP and VMS platforms; intercompany billing across related companies in different countries; setting up a new office or managing external advisers.

**Why this role**

* Founding seat in a new India headquarters, with the authority to design how it runs
* Direct line to the CEO. Your work is seen, and your decisions carry
* Cross-border scope: U.S. and India finance, tax, compliance and staffing operations in one role
* A path to Head of India Business Operations as the company grows

**To apply**

Send your resume directly to Sunny Patel at
**Sunny.Patel@stepstalent.com**
, copying
**Shree.Singh@stepstalent.com**
, with the
**subject line “Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing) - Ahmedabad”**
.

In three lines, tell us the hardest operations problem you have fixed. Direct applicants only.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Profile:**

**Senior Manager / Deputy General Manager – Warehouse & Logistics Operations (Domestic Market)**

**Reporting To:**
Head – Global Logistics & Distribution

**Location**
: Ahmedabad, Mumbai

**Purpose of the Role:**

To lead and manage end-to-end warehousing, distribution, transportation, and inventory operations across the domestic market, ensuring optimum product availability, superior customer service levels, cost-effective logistics, efficient order fulfilment, inventory optimization, vendor performance management, and continuous process improvement in pharmaceutical Industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Warehouse & Distribution Management**

* Lead end-to-end warehousing and distribution operations across domestic market
* Ensure timely dispatch and delivery of Finished Goods (FG) to CFA locations and distribution points.
* Monitor logistics performance through key metrics such as OTIF (On-Time In-Full), fill rate, dispatch adherence, and delivery turnaround time.
* Ensure product availability across all stocking locations to support uninterrupted market servicing.
* Select and manage transportation partners for primary and secondary distribution.
* Negotiate freight rates, transportation contracts, and service-level agreements.
* Monitor transporter performance, vehicle availability, transit lead times, and delivery compliance.
* Optimize route planning, vehicle utilization, freight costs, and transportation efficiency.

**2. Vendor Management & Commercial Excellence**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage logistics service providers, warehouse operators, and transport partners.
* Lead commercial negotiations to achieve cost optimization and improved service performance.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews and implement corrective and improvement actions.
* Ensure compliance with contractual commitments and agreed service standards.
* Monitor inventory health and ensure optimum stock levels across warehouses, hubs, and CFA locations.
* Manage inventory replenishment through effective DRP (Distribution Requirement Planning) and deployment planning.
* Coordinate with Production, Demand, Planning, Sales, and Commercial teams to achieve targeted service levels.
* Coordinate dispatch planning based on sales forecasts and market demand.
* Maintain high inventory accuracy through adherence to FIFO/FEFO practices and inventory controls.
* Monitor KPIs related to inventory accuracy, damage control, dispatch turnaround time, and warehouse efficiency.

**3. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, and Quality teams.
* Align distribution plans with business demand and market requirements.
* Support new product launches, promotional campaigns, and distribution initiatives.

**4. MIS, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop logistics dashboards, management reports, and performance scorecards.
* Analyze logistics costs, warehouse productivity, inventory ageing, and service performance.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, statutory requirements, and quality standards.
* Lead internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Drive digitization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across logistics operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Logistics Cost as % of Sales
* Transportation Cost Reduction
* Freight Cost Savings
* OTIF (On-Time In-Full) Performance
* DRP & RSP Planning Effectiveness
* Inventory Accuracy and Cycle Count Compliance
* Warehouse Productivity & Space Utilization
* Vendor Performance Compliance
* SOP Compliance & Implementation
* Internal & External Audit Compliance

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Operations, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics preferred.

**Experience**

* 15–25 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical Warehousing, Logistics, Distribution, and Supply Chain Management.

**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. **Job Title**
: Senior Manager, PS
  
  
**Locations**
