**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate, support for growth through individual and team development, and an environment where all voices can be heard.
  
  
**Conga**
crushes complexity within an increasingly complex world. With our revenue lifecycle management solution, we transform your unique complexities for order configuration, execution, fulfillment, and contract renewal processes with a single critical insights data model that adapts to ever-changing business requirements and aligns the understanding and efforts of every team.
  
  
**Our mission**
: Empower customers to deliver transformational revenue growth by aligning teams, processes, and technology to maximize customer lifetime value.
  
  
Our approach is grounded in the Conga Way, a framework for what we stand for and everything we do as an organization — from hiring to decision making and product development. Developed with direct input from our colleagues, the Conga Way is the foundation for our culture.
  
  
**A quick snapshot**
**…**
A Senior Manager will build and manage an effective team from offshore centre. It includes hiring, training, coaching, retaining, and measuring the effectiveness of a high-performing PS delivery team. Be a problem solver and a guide, coach, mentor, and a strong communicator.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
The Senior Manager will play a key role in building a strong and effective team who will deal with different situations while working on the projects.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.**
Must have 15+ years of experience in the IT industry, with strong experience in building and managing high-performing teams. Should have solid experience coordinating with global and offshore teams, along with full lifecycle enterprise software implementation experience. Experience working with Conga products such as CPQ and CLM, or with any CRM or SaaS platform, will be a strong added advantage.
  
  
**Strong communication and interpersonal skills.**
You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles, and when you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our customers and stakeholders and allow you to accurately gather the right information so you can resolve issues in the most effective way.
  
  
**Natural collaborator.**
You work effectively across functions — with Delivery Teams, Practice Directors, Regional Heads and customer stakeholders — to drive successful project outcomes. You are proficient with Agile and have a collaborative, cross-functional approach to delivering great solutions. You are comfortable working across multiple teams and championing best practices. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. You don’t know any other way, It’s a team effort and you completely appreciate that.
  
  
**People leadership and development.**
You take genuine ownership of your team — hiring, coaching, mentoring, and retaining top talent. You invest in each individual’s career growth and skill expansion, building clear development paths and a culture where people do their best work and want to stay.
  
  
**Driving initiatives and an AI-first mindset.**
You lead organizational initiatives that raise the bar for delivery, and you champion AI-driven ways of working to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes. You proactively identify opportunities to innovate and bring your team along with you.
  
  
**Subject matter expertise.**
You serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Conga’s enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges and how our solutions solve them. You bring credibility to customer conversations and help your team navigate complex enterprise implementations.
  
  
**Education.**
A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field is highly preferred.

**Passion**
. We know it when we see it. Passion is not about saying how much you love what you do in your most excited voice. Passion is revealed in your truest self. It’s about what you’ve accomplished; how you want to grow; the ideas you have; your philosophies. It’s demonstrating through your words and your actions that you truly believe in what you do -- and where you work. That it matters to you. And that’s pretty cool.
  
  
**Initiative**
. You don’t wait around for things to happen or for your manager to tell you what to do. You’re not only proactive about completing your own work, but when you sense the need to introduce a project that will benefit the team or the organization -- even if it’s outside your scope of work -- you put a proposal together, talk to the team about it, and
*own it*
. And that also goes back to having an entrepreneurial spirt

**Preferred Resume Format**

title: Credit Team Leader – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, work from office · CTC ₹15 LPA+ (base, premium and bonus)**

Own client delivery for an Australian finance broking firm. You lead the team that carries every loan file from first application to settlement, and you carry the complex files yourself. For a senior loan processor or credit lead with five or more years in lending, ideally on Australian mortgages, and real experience leading people.

Applications close Sunday 1st November 2026.

**WHO YOU WOULD BE JOINING**

Prevail Finance is a boutique Australian finance broking firm, founded in Melbourne in 2017 and working Australia-wide under Australian Credit Licence 509527. A finance broker arranges loans for clients from a panel of lenders; ours has more than 65. We arrange complex residential, business acquisition, commercial property, SMSF commercial, development and construction, and debt restructure lending. Four people today. You would lead the part of the firm that delivers every loan we write.

Established in 2017, Melbourne. Transaction range $400k–$10M+ AUD. 65+ lenders on panel. 50+ five-star Google reviews.

Priyank Thakkar, Founder — he assessed and approved business loans as a bank Lending Manager and Commercial Credit Analyst before he started arranging them. Master of Commerce (Professional Accounting), twelve years in lending, and still developing property himself. What you learn here is current practice, not textbook theory.

Member — Finance Brokers Association of Australia, Australian Institute of Business Brokers, SMSF Association.

Where and when — Gandhinagar, Gujarat, alongside our existing Gandhinagar team. Ahmedabad and areas within about 30 km are within commuting distance; you do not need to relocate. Monday to Saturday, on Australian business hours: an early-morning start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

Client delivery, end to end. Every active file has a clear status, an owner and a next action, and every loan settles on time, to standard. You report directly to the founder. As the firm grows, a General Manager will be appointed and this role will report to them. Advice to clients is given by the licence holder, not by this role.

You lead — a senior loan processor with almost five years on our files, a client experience coordinator who handles onboarding, document collection and client updates, a junior processor you will help choose, and whoever joins the team next.

Your week — about 60% your own files and 40% leading, until the junior processor is productive. Then 40% files and 60% leading. The split is written into your role agreement.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

Own the pipeline. Allocate every file by priority, capacity and capability, with a named owner, a next action and a due date. Run the weekly pipeline review and raise settlement risk early.

Carry the complex files. Personally manage complex applications from handover to settlement: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, and business and commercial lending as you learn it.

Hold the quality line. Review documents, servicing inputs and application readiness before anything reaches a lender, and confirm every file passes its required checks: customer identity (VOI), anti-money-laundering (AML/CTF) and Australian credit rules (NCCP, Best Interests Duty).

Work the lenders. Research policy, resolve lender queries, and work with relationship managers on pricing requests, policy exceptions, conditions and valuations.

Lead the people. Set clear standards for quality, communication and turnaround. Coach, review work, and hold the accountability conversation yourself when a standard slips.

Grow the team. Own your team’s training and development, sit on the panel for every hire into your team, and build the training that makes a new processor independent.

Fix what repeats. When the same problem comes back twice, find the cause and change the workflow so it stops.

Escalate well. Decide within your agreed authority. Bring material risks to the founder early, with the facts, the action already taken and your recommended next step.

**WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU**

Five or more years in mortgage or credit processing, in any market, owning complex files end to end.

Real experience leading people: allocating work, coaching, and holding colleagues to a standard, with or without the title.

Australian residential mortgage processing, end-to-end, is preferred. US or UK mortgage experience, or other credit processing, is also welcome; we will train you on Australian lending.

Australian business, commercial, SMSF or construction lending, ApplyOnline and Australian lender portals are an advantage. We use SalesTrekker as our CRM and will train you on it.

A degree in accounting, finance, commerce or banking.

Clear written and spoken English: you will write file notes and speak with Australian lenders every day.

Experience gets your CV read. Judgement gets you the job. We hire people who check carefully and then move, make the call within their authority, and can hold a colleague to a standard both kindly and directly.

**WHO THRIVES HERE**

You are accurate by habit, and quick to move once the checks are done. You are comfortable making the call within your authority. You are patient when teaching, direct when a standard slips, and calm when two settlements are at risk on the same morning.

You are not waiting to be told what comes next, redoing work yourself instead of teaching someone to do it right, letting a missed standard slide to keep the peace, or sending routine decisions up to the founder.

**WHAT YOU GET FROM US**

Real authority, in writing. What you decide alone, what you consult on and what you escalate: a starter version in your role agreement before your first day, finalised with the founder by day 30.

A structured 90-day onboarding. Our check-ins step back as you take ownership.

Training on whatever you have not done yet: Australian lending, business and commercial files, and our systems. Paid for by the firm.

Direct access to the founder, who assessed these loans inside the banks before he ever arranged one.

A team to build. You help choose your first hire.

What we cannot train is the wanting to. That part you bring.

**HOW WE WORK**

You will not be chased. You are given a result to achieve, the authority to achieve it, and the resources you need. Nobody checks whether you have started. You are expected to start.

The checklist is the minimum, not the maximum. Following the process is the basic requirement of the role. We need people who notice what the checklist missed and fix it before anyone asks.

Your work is measured. Turnaround time, compliance completeness, on-time settlements and client experience are reviewed every week, openly, in front of the whole team. For this role, so is how your team performs.

**PAY**

CTC ₹15 LPA+, including base, premium and bonus: a top-of-market package for the right person.

Base — for holding the role and meeting its standard.

Premium — as you develop and deliver at a higher level.

Bonus — for clearing a specific, difficult, time-bound project.

Most of it is fixed base salary, by design, because compliance work must never be influenced by a bonus. The final figure is benchmarked and agreed individually, and we discuss it openly at the first conversation.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email your CV, your current location, your notice period and your answers to the three questions below to priyank@prevailfinance.com.au. A paragraph each is enough. Write them yourself, in your own words.

Subject line: Credit Team Leader – your name

One. Tell us about a loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, and that you personally turned around. What was wrong, what did you do, and what happened?

Two. Tell us about a time you held a colleague to a standard they were not meeting. What did you say, what did you do next, and what happened?

Three. Tell us one thing in this advertisement you disagree with, or would do differently. Tell us why.

Question three is not a trick. It is the answer we read first.

Both steps count. Applications without the emailed answers are not assessed.

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Applications are read in the order they arrive, so earlier is better.

Every applicant receives a reply, including those not selected.

Shortlisted applicants are contacted within a week of the closing date for a 15-minute call, then an interview with the founder that includes a short practical exercise. If we receive many strong applications, we may first ask for a two-minute audio recording.

On appointment, a written role agreement covering title, responsibilities, authority and pay structure is provided before you start.

The first three months are a window to show the role is working, for both sides. If it is not, we part ways positively and without drama.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

What success looks like, so you can judge us against it too.

By day 30: you know every live file and its next step, the weekly pipeline review is yours, and your decision rights are signed off in writing.

By day 60: you hold standards conversations without the founder in the room, and you have helped choose the junior processor.

By day 90: the founder no longer chases files or allocates work, check-ins have moved to exceptions only, and your first workflow fix is live.

**BEFORE YOU APPLY**

Background check — this role leads the team that handles client credit files, so appointment requires a police check and clearance against ASIC’s banned and disqualified persons register. Standard for the industry, arranged by the firm.

Fair assessment — every application is assessed against the same standard. We do not discriminate on age, gender, background, family responsibilities, or anything else with no bearing on the work.

If this reads like a description of how you already work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Assistant General Manager - CRM
description:
**Job Description:**

**Department:**
Ortho

**Job Title:**
Assistant General Manager - CRM

**Job Location:**
Corporate Office, Ahmedabad

**Experience Required:**
15 to 20 Years

**Role Objective:**

* To lead and govern the international distribution business and customer relationship management function for the
  **Ortho vertical.**
  The role is accountable for
  **export sales invoicing**
  ,
  **customer acquisition and upgrades**
  ,
  **premium-product revenue mix**
  ,
  **DSO and collections, forecasting, order-to-cash governance, customer service, distributor management, process compliance, digital transformation**
  through SAP and Salesforce, and the development of a robust CRM organization. The role must provide clear commercial direction, review performance at defined intervals, remove execution bottlenecks and ensure that business commitments are delivered through disciplined cross-functional coordination.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**International Business Strategy and Revenue Delivery**

* Translate the approved annual international distribution strategy into market-wise, quarter-wise and customer-wise execution plans.
* Own the achievement of the approved export distribution sales invoicing target and review progress against quarterly milestones.
* Drive year-on-year growth through existing-customer expansion, new customer acquisition, customer upgrades and improved premium-product penetration.
* Review the performance of assigned regions, distribution partners, direct offices and customer segments, and implement corrective actions for target gaps.
* Lead preparation for the annual business plan and budget process and ensure that the operating plan is supported by realistic forecasts, customer actions and collection plans.

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Engage existing and potential international customers for business development and relationship expansion.
* Establish customer-segmentation priorities and ensure structured engagement with A and B customers, along with periodic follow-up for C and D customers.
* Drive business from new and upgraded customers in line with the approved annual and quarterly contribution targets.
* Review regional opportunities, market constraints, forecast-versus-actual gaps and customer-specific actions with regional stakeholders.

**CRM and Customer-Service Governance**

* Ensure a high and consistent level of service to existing and potential customers throughout the enquiry-to-order, order-to-shipment and post-shipment lifecycle.
* Lead CRM governance across assigned markets, including customer master data, follow-up trackers, customer health reports, customer feedback, open-point closure and service escalations.
* Ensure timely customer communication on order status, documentation, payments, shipment schedules, complaints, returns and regulatory requirements.
* Review customer follow-up presentations, customer-focused inputs, collected 4Q feedback and customer action plans before management reviews.
* Ensure that the CRM team maintains complete, accurate and current records in Salesforce, SAP and approved trackers.

**Sales Forecasting, Invoice Planning and Performance Reviews**

* Govern the 12-week rolling forecast process and ensure that forecast inputs are collected, validated, consolidated and reviewed at the prescribed frequency.
* Review the monthly invoice plan, expected sales and collection position, order pipeline, dispatch readiness and forecast-versus-actual challenges.
* Review sales, order, invoice and collection dashboards and ensure that data is available for global sales and collection performance meetings.
* Ensure periodic review of order-to-shipment reports, customer health reports, pending sales orders and key operational trackers.

**Order-to-Cash, DSO and Collection Control**

* Own DSO performance for the assigned international distribution business and drive progressive achievement of the approved quarterly DSO milestones.
* Review customer ledgers, overdue and due receivables, collection plans, credit risks and shipment holds with the CRM team.
* Ensure that monthly collection plans are prepared, communicated and actively followed up with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that proforma invoices, sales contracts and orders are processed within the approved turnaround time, subject to receipt of advance payment where applicable.
* Ensure that orders are correctly created, verified, approved and released in SAP and that OBD, invoicing and shipment activities are completed within defined service levels.
* Escalate material payment, credit, documentation or shipment risks early and ensure closure through cross-functional coordination.

**Distributor Agreements and Commercial Documentation**

* Oversee preparation, validation, issuance and execution of distributor agreements for assigned markets.
* Ensure that agreement data is correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP and Salesforce.
* Oversee preparation and customer acceptance of sales contracts, pro forma invoices and related commercial documents for each order.
* Drive implementation and adoption of the Agreement Module in Salesforce in accordance with the approved project plan and go-live milestone.
* Ensure document completeness, version control, approval compliance and accessibility for audit and operational use.

**Logistics, Shipment and Inventory Coordination**

* Review order and logistics efficiency, pending dispatches, shipment risks and order-to-shipment performance with CRM and logistics stakeholders.
* Support the transition and review of FOB-to-CIF processes and ensure that nominated-agent details are made available for FOB shipments where required.
* Review non-moving stock and ensure that market, customer and shipment actions are defined and tracked to reduce inventory risk.
* Ensure timely resolution of documentation, payment, regulatory and logistics issues that may delay shipment.
* Govern implementation of the Salesforce Freight Portal and ensure process adoption after go-live.

**Regulatory, Quality, PMS and Returns Coordination**

* Ensure that product registration information and certificates received from customers or regional teams are shared with the Regulatory function in a timely manner.
* Ensure follow-up on product registration trackers with the Regulatory team for assigned markets.
* Ensure collection and tracking of customer-wise and product-wise post-market-surveillance feedback in line with defined requirements.
* Ensure that customer complaints are supported by complete complaint forms and routed through the approved quality-management process, including Track Wise/DMS activities.
* Ensure that goods-return details are correctly processed in SAP after confirmation from the relevant stores or operations team.
* Support applicable MDR and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of assigned observations.

**Systems, Digital Transformation and Process Improvement**

* Drive SAP-Salesforce automation, Salesforce master-data quality, process controls and management dashboards, including Power BI or other approved tools.
* Lead the Agreement Module and Freight Portal projects in Salesforce from project initiation through go-live and stabilization.
* Support development and adoption of online PMS feedback tools and other approved CRM/process solutions.
* Review process performance, identify control gaps, standardize workflows and sponsor continuous-improvement initiatives through the Menlo Park/Kaizen mechanism.

**Management Reporting, Meetings and Compliance**

* Prepare and present accurate information for management reviews, global sales and collection performance meetings, customer-focused meetings and business-plan discussions.
* Ensure that dashboards, trackers and review packs clearly show target achievement, DSO, collections, forecasts, customer actions, premium-product mix, new/upgrade business and project status.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* International distribution sales strategy and business development
* CRM governance, customer lifecycle management and service escalation
* Sales forecasting, gap analysis, pipeline and performance dashboards
* DSO, receivables, collection planning and credit-risk management
* Order-to-cash process, SAP order release, OBD, invoicing and shipment coordination
* Distributor agreements, sales contracts and proforma-invoice governance
* SAP and Salesforce implementation, automation and master-data control
* Management reporting, Power BI/analytics and executive presentations
* Regulatory registration, PMS feedback, complaint and returns coordination
* Process improvement, SOP governance, audits, budgeting and project management
* Team structure design, performance management, coaching and capability building

**Behavioural Skills Required:**

* Customer orientation and service ownership
* Commercial drive, aggressiveness and will to win
* Innovation, adaptability and change leadership
* Entrepreneurial thinking and opportunity orientation
* Passion, commitment and personal accountability
* Analytical thinking and evidence-based decision-making
* Clear communication, influencing and cross-cultural stakeholder management
* Respectful people leadership, coaching, collaboration, high process discipline, integrity, effective prioritization and timely action closure

**Team Size to be Handled:**

* Role involves managing a team of 2 members.

**Specific Professional Competencies:**

* Business Acumen, Customer Focus, Drive for results, Problem-solving, Peer relationship, Negotiation skills, Functional/ technical skills, Presentation skills, Adherence to Ethics and Values, Integrity.

**Important Links:**

* Website: https://biotechhealthcare.com/
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/biotechhealthcare/
* Instagram: Biotech Vision Care

title: Lead - Treasury
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Treasury & Liquidity Management**

* Lead treasury operations, cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and fund management across the business.
* Develop short-term and long-term cash flow plans to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
* Drive working capital optimization initiatives and improve cash conversion cycles.
* Monitor fund utilization, liquidity positions, borrowing costs, and treasury risk exposure.
* Coordinate with Group Treasury for fund deployment, cash pooling, and liquidity management strategies.

**Fund Raising & Project Finance**

* Lead end-to-end fund-raising activities for existing and upcoming projects.
* Manage project financing, including lender engagement, financial closure, documentation, drawdowns, and disbursements.
* Evaluate and implement optimal financing structures through debt, equity, structured finance, and hybrid instruments.

**Banking Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, investors, and rating agencies.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, credit facilities, banking limits, and financing terms.
* Lead consortium banking arrangements and multi-bank financing structures.
* Manage enhancement and renewal of working capital and project finance facilities.

**Trade Finance & Banking Operations**

* Manage end-to-end trade finance transactions, including:

+ Import & Export Letters of Credit (LCs)
+ Bank Guarantees (BGs)
+ Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs)
+ Buyers' and Suppliers' Credit

* Oversee issuance, amendments, negotiations, renewals, and closure of trade finance instruments.
* Ensure timely settlement of import/export transactions and compliance with banking obligations.

**Debt Management & Compliance**

* Manage debt portfolio, including drawdowns, repayments, refinancing, interest servicing, and covenant monitoring.
* Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender reporting, and debt covenants.
* Prepare CMA data, stock statements, drawing power calculations, utilization certificates, and banking MIS.
* Ensure compliance with RBI, FEMA, banking regulations, and trade finance guidelines.
* Monitor documentation, statutory submissions, and regulatory reporting requirements.

**Forex & Risk Management**

* Manage foreign exchange exposures arising from imports, exports, borrowings, and cross-border transactions.
* Develop and implement hedging strategies through forward contracts and other treasury products.
* Monitor interest rate and currency risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Ensure adherence to treasury risk management frameworks and policies.

**Treasury Digitalization & Process Excellence**

* Drive treasury automation initiatives and implementation of digital banking platforms.
* Improve treasury workflows through technology-enabled solutions and process optimization.
* Establish treasury controls, governance frameworks, and best practices.
* Enhance operational efficiency through dashboarding, automation, and reporting tools.

**MIS & Leadership Reporting**

* Prepare treasury dashboards, cash position reports, debt reports, banking MIS, and fund utilization reports.
* Present key treasury metrics and funding updates to senior management.
* Provide actionable insights on liquidity, borrowing costs, treasury risks, and capital deployment.

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification**

* CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA / FRM from a reputed institution.
* Additional certification in Treasury, Project Finance, Financial Modelling, or Risk Management will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 15-20+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Project Finance, Corporate Finance, or Fund Raising.
* Proven experience in large manufacturing, metals, mining, natural resources, infrastructure, power, EPC, or capital-intensive industries.
* Extensive exposure to project funding, structured finance, lender negotiations, and debt management.
* Experience in handling multi-bank arrangements, consortium financing, and large capital expenditure projects.

 We are further strengthening our Inventory Management organization. Therefore, we are seeking a
 **Manager, Global Manufacturing Inventories** 
 to join us within the Consumables (CNS) Business Area.

 You will develop, implement and maintain our different levels of guidelines and metrics. An essential part of this role is to drive the development and implementation of global planning and inventory governance for rubber compound manufacturing.

description:
Job Title: Head / Team Leader – Training (Injection Molding Business)
   

  

 Location: Ahmedabad, or as per business requirements
   

  

 Department: Technical Training / Sales Enablement / Customer Success
   

  

 Job Summary: Build, lead, and scale a structured training function for internal teams and customers, focusing on technical excellence, customer capability, and commercialization of training programs in injection molding and plastics processing.
   

  

 Education: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or Polymer Engineering; MBA preferred
   

  

 Experience: 10\+ years in the injection molding industry, with proven leadership exposure
   

  

**Managerial Skills**
 Proven experience in the following areas:
   

  

* Training and capability development
* Revenue generation and business development
* Technical Skills:
* Strong knowledge of injection molding machines and processes
* Knowledge of plastic processing technologies, including extrusion and blow molding, will be an added advantage
* Commercial understanding with the ability to support revenue growth
* Functional Skills:
* Program and project management, including scheduling and Gantt chart planning
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen
* Development of technical and commercial training content
* Business planning with a focus on revenue generation
* Behavioral Competencies:
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills
* Strategic mindset with a strong execution focus
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams


**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and implement training strategies, frameworks, and certification pathways
* Deliver technical training to Sales \& Service teams; track effectiveness
* Design and conduct customer training (onsite, workshops, webinars)
* Develop technical \& sales enablement content (manuals, videos, SOPs, etc.)
* Build and monetize training programs (certifications, paid workshops, annual plans)
* Collaborating with Sales, Service, and Marketing for program execution and revenue growth
* Manage training schedules, resources, and delivery quality


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Year\-on\-year growth of the training function
* Number of Paid training programs.
* Customer participation levels and feedback scores
* Sales \& Service teams capability improvement
* Quality and output of training content


 Ideal Candidate: A techno\-commercial leader with strong domain expertise in plastics processing and a passion for building scalable, high\-impact training programs.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900\+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end\-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US\-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.
   

  

**Eeo**

We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron.com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Sr. Project Engineer - Site Based
description:
Experience:
 
 8–12\+ years relevant site / construction / PMC experience
 
 Reporting to Project Lead
 
 · Report directly to the Project Lead for routine project matters on the assigned project.
 



 · Translate project objectives, priorities and decisions into site action.
 



 · Keep the Project Lead informed of progress, risks, technical issues, contractor performance and constraints.
 



 · Implement legitimate project directions issued by the Project Lead.
 



 · Raise technical concerns professionally with reasoning, evidence and alternatives.
 



 · Do not seek parallel or conflicting approvals from senior management for routine matters.
 


 Site Leadership
 
 · Lead the Gray Matter site team.
 



 · Allocate responsibilities among PE, Jr. PE and Supervisors.
 



 · Set daily and weekly site priorities.
 



 · Coordinate with contractor site teams and specialist agencies.
 



 · Maintain professional site discipline and ensure site records are dependable.
 



 · Develop junior team members through instruction, review and feedback.
 


 Construction, Quality \& Safety
 
 · Monitor construction against approved drawings and specifications.
 



 · Monitor manpower, materials, work fronts and productivity.
 



 · Implement and monitor QAP / ITPs / checklists.
 



 · Inspect workmanship and materials.
 



 · Track NCRs, defects and corrective actions.
 



 · Escalate significant safety or quality concerns immediately.
 


 Programme, Design \& Technical Coordination
 
 · Monitor actual site progress against programme.
 



 · Identify slippage, constraints and root causes.
 



 · Recommend recovery actions to the Project Lead.
 



 · Review drawings and technical submissions.
 



 · Raise RFIs and coordinate technical resolution through the prescribed route.
 



 · Identify recurring technical issues that may inform Gray Matter's Construction Intelligence.
 


 Commercial \& Reporting
 
 · Verify measurements and review contractor bills within assigned responsibilities.
 



 · Identify variations and potential claims.
 



 · Provide accurate site information for commercial decisions.
 



 · Provide reliable daily/weekly site intelligence to the Project Lead.
 



 · Maintain accurate site information in GM\-Sync / prescribed project systems.
 



 · Ensure site information is factual, current and traceable.
 


 Direct Senior Management Access
 
 · Direct access remains available for critical safety, ethical, contractual, financial, technical or Client matters; matters specifically requested by senior management; or where normal escalation is not reasonably available.
 



 · Where practicable, the Project Lead should be kept informed.
 



 · Direct escalation does not remove the Senior PE's obligation to maintain the project reporting structure.
 


 Expected Level of Independence
 
 · Independently leads the site team and resolves routine construction issues.
 



 · Needs support mainly for complex, strategic or cross\-functional matters.
 



 · Respects Project Lead authority while retaining professional and technical judgement.
 



 · Is expected to challenge unsafe, technically unsound or materially risky directions rather than silently complying.
 


 What Good Looks Like
 
 · Site is controlled rather than merely observed.
 



 · Project Lead receives accurate information before issues become project crises.
 



 · Junior team understands priorities and standards.
 



 · Quality, safety and programme risks are actively managed.
 



 · The site team can function effectively without daily intervention from the Founder.
 


 Qualifications \& Experience
 
 · Degree/diploma in Civil Engineering or related discipline preferred.
 



 · Substantial site/construction/PMC experience.
 



 · Experience leading site teams or major work packages preferred.
 


 Core Competencies
 
 · Site leadership
 



 · Construction management
 



 · Quality / safety
 



 · Drawing interpretation
 



 · Programme monitoring
 



 · Technical problem solving
 



 · Contractor management
 



 · Reporting
 



 · Team development
 



 · Site intelligence

title: Indirect Channel Account Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
 To deliver top line growth by selling Shell CVPs to preferred segments through a network of selected, committed, structured and profitable Distributors, in line with Shell HSSE policy and Shell General Business Principles.
   

  

 To manage all Distributors as profit centers by adding value to their business with a partnership and process driven approach, by creating cross\-functional business linkages with them, and by making them consider Shell as their preferred business partner
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Ensure that Distributors recruit, develop, motivate and retain a sales force that delivers sustainable performance and provide appropriate support for grooming sales of the distributors.
* Ensure implementation and growth of CPT for the territory through usage of tool Pipeline Manager and constructive reviews of the tool with MILO, WILO, DILO.
* Ensure each Distributor is aligned in goal, capability, business focus and capital resources to maximize Shell business and agree a multi\-yearly Business Plan that is fully aligned with Shell Marketing strategy and targets, and deliver activities that allow to deliver performance and to develop profitable and sustainable business for both Shell and Distributors.
* Agree, monitor and achieve targets, for both new and existing Distributors and contribute to the overall team performance:
+ Financial performance indicators: Volume, Revenue, Margin, Credit DSO and Controllable Costs Sales Productivity performance indicators: CPT, Business Plan quality, SPANCOP pipeline Strength, Target Delivered, Hit Rate, Cycle Time, Customer Churn, Indirect Channel Efficiency, and Revenue and Margin per Distributor.


- Implement Shell Distributor Value Proposition (DVP) in order to increase Mind Share to Shell from Distributors such like:

* Provide Sales Support by visiting Distributors key accounts and by engaging all functions in Shell that could help at delivering customer promise. Act as business consultant, to efficiently manage relations with the Distributors and to audit/improve financial performance ratios Deliver agreed marketing programs and materials to increase the value to Shell and Distributor through a range of cross\-sell, up\-sell and new\-sell activities. Successfully migrate profitable accounts from Shell to Distributors control
* Ensure linkages with marketing team by implementing Marketing Plan (CVP, Pricing, Brand \& Communications campaigns) and by monitoring and reporting market trends and competition initiatives, strengths and weaknesses.
* Develop and maintain good working relationships with all Support Functions to assist sales in resolving complex issues and improve Distributors and Customers satisfaction.
* Link business plans to external alignment and shared vision. Review and identifying distributor capability assessment current versus future and developing actions on gap closure.


**What We Need From You**
* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Indirect Sales, preferably within a distributor\-led or channel sales environment.
* Proven track record of driving top\-line growth through indirect sales channels and distributor networks.

* Experience in managing distributors as profit centers, including business planning, performance management, and profitability improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to assess business performance, identify growth opportunities, and improve distributor profitability and return on investment (ROI).
* Proven ability to analyze sales data, conduct business reviews, and develop actionable strategies to improve commercial outcomes.
* Experience in guiding, coaching, and developing Distributor Sales Managers (DSMs) and distributor sales teams to achieve business objectives.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate teams, improve morale, and drive high\-performance sales cultures through effective coaching in selling and negotiation techniques.
* Experience in sales pipeline management and sales performance tracking, including the use of CRM or pipeline management tools to drive execution excellence.
* Ability to train and coach distributor sales teams on technical product knowledge, consultative selling, and negotiation skills to improve conversion rates within target sectors.
* Demonstrated experience in working with cross\-functional teams, including marketing and technical functions, to develop and implement customer value propositions (CVPs) tailored to local market segments.
* Experience supporting and leading strategic customer conversions, including large OEMs, for both initial fill and aftermarket sales opportunities.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build and maintain long\-term distributor relationships through a partnership\-driven and process\-oriented approach.
* Commitment to upholding Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) standards and conducting business in accordance with ethical and compliance principles.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, negotiation, and business development skills.

title: Senior Manager – Semiconductor Test Manufacturing
description:
Senior Manager Semiconductor Test Manufacturing
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Onsite
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience Range:** 
 18\- 25 Years
 



  





**Industry:** 
 Semiconductor Manufacturing / ATMP / OSAT / Memory Products
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Manager Semiconductor Test Manufacturing to lead high\-volume semiconductor test operations at an advanced assembly, testing, marking and packaging facility. The position will be responsible for manufacturing performance, production readiness, capacity, yield, quality, cost and cycle time across the test organization.
 



 The role requires extensive semiconductor manufacturing leadership experience, strong knowledge of ATE\-based production testing and the ability to build disciplined, data\-driven operations in a 24 7 manufacturing environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead high\-volume semiconductor test manufacturing operations across assigned production areas.
* Own manufacturing performance for safety, quality, yield, output, cost, cycle time and delivery.
* Develop and execute test\-manufacturing strategies aligned with production and business plans.
* Establish production readiness for new and existing DRAM, NAND, memory\-module or semiconductor products.
* Manage production capacity, equipment utilization, staffing, shift coverage and product\-mix requirements.
* Partner with test engineering, equipment engineering, process engineering and product engineering teams.
* Monitor test yield, retest rates, equipment downtime, throughput and operational efficiency.
* Drive structured problem\-solving for production excursions, yield losses and equipment\-related constraints.
* Implement manufacturing controls, operating procedures and escalation mechanisms.
* Support new\-product introduction and transfer of products from engineering into volume manufacturing.
* Drive cycle\-time reduction, cost improvement, productivity and manufacturing excellence initiatives.
* Maintain compliance with internal quality systems, customer requirements and applicable industry standards.
* Establish performance dashboards and use production data to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Build manufacturing capability through recruitment, training, mentoring and succession planning.
* Lead supervisors, managers, engineers and production teams in a 24 7 manufacturing environment.
* Coordinate with planning, materials, quality and supply\-chain teams to meet output and delivery commitments.
* Promote Lean Manufacturing, TPM, automation and AI\-enabled decision\-making across operations.
* Present manufacturing performance, risks and recovery plans to senior leadership.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline.
* Master s degree in Engineering, Operations or Business Management is preferred.
* 18 25 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, assembly and test, OSAT, ATMP or a related high\-volume electronics environment.
* Minimum 8 10 years of experience leading manufacturing teams, managers or large production organizations.
* Demonstrated experience in semiconductor test manufacturing or backend semiconductor operations.
* Proven responsibility for production output, yield, equipment utilization, quality, cost and cycle time.
* Experience managing 24 7 manufacturing operations and multi\-shift teams.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing planning, capacity modelling and resource allocation.
* Experience working with engineering, quality, planning, maintenance and supply\-chain functions.



 Technical Skills Semiconductor Test Manufacturing
 


* Semiconductor assembly and test operations
* ATE\-based production testing
* Final test and system\-level test operations
* Memory or semiconductor product testing
* Test handlers, sockets, load boards and test interfaces
* Production test flow and test\-floor management
* New\-product introduction and volume ramp\-up



 Manufacturing Operations
 


* High\-volume manufacturing
* Capacity and production planning
* Workforce and shift planning
* Product\-mix management
* Manufacturing readiness
* Production control and execution
* Bottleneck and constraint management
* Operational performance management



 Manufacturing Metrics
 


* Test yield and retest rate
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness
* Equipment availability and utilization
* Units per hour and throughput
* Cycle time and work\-in\-progress
* Cost per unit
* On\-time delivery
* Scrap and defect reduction



 Quality and Problem\-Solving
 


* Statistical Process Control
* Failure Mode and Effects Analysis
* 8D problem\-solving
* Root\-cause analysis
* Corrective and preventive action
* Process excursion management
* Quality\-system compliance
* ISO 9001 and applicable semiconductor standards



 Operational Excellence
 


* Lean Manufacturing
* Six Sigma
* Total Productive Maintenance
* Theory of Constraints
* Continuous improvement
* Factory automation
* Data analytics and dashboards
* AI\-enabled manufacturing decision support

title: Calibration Laboratory Head
description:
Job Title: Calibration Laboratory Head
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Company: Oizom Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
 



  





**About Oizom:** 




 Oizom is a leading environmental monitoring solutions company, building innovative sensor\-based platforms to measure, analyze, and visualize environmental data. Our solutions help governments, industries, and researchers make data\-driven decisions for cleaner and healthier environments.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are hiring a Calibration Laboratory Head to lead the technical direction and quality oversight of our calibration laboratory for gas, dust, and meteorological instruments. This role involves defining calibration processes, developing SOPs, planning setups for new parameters and capabilities, and driving measurement accuracy improvement through structured testing.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs):** 




 ● Develop and maintain calibration SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation across gas, dust, and meteorological parameters
 



 ● Plan and define calibration setups for new parameters, instrument types, or measurement ranges — providing technical specifications, workflow design, and environmental requirements
 



 ● Design and supervise testing experiments to identify and reduce sources of measurement error — linearity, drift, cross\-sensitivity, and environmental influence studies
 



 ● Set calibration quality standards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement
 



 ● Prepare and maintain measurement uncertainty budgets and ensure traceability to national/international standards
 



 ● Build and maintain quality documentation and processes aligned to ISO/IEC 17025 standards
 



 ● Provide technical direction, training, and mentorship to the team.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, Applied Physics, Atmospheric Science, Metrology, or a related field
 



 ● Minimum 4 years of hands\-on experience in a calibration or testing laboratory environment, with a total professional experience of 6\+ years preferred.
 



 ● Strong understanding of measurement uncertainty estimation and GUM methodology
 



 ● Experience with gas analyzers, dust/particulate monitors, or meteorological sensors
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to write SOPs, design calibration workflows, and build technical documentation ● Proven ability to lead and coordinate with technical teams
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● Experience with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation processes
 



 ● ISO/IEC 17025 Internal Auditor or Lead Assessor certification
 



 ● Experience in designing testing experiments, method validation, or accuracy improvement initiatives ● Familiarity with air quality regulatory standards and calibration protocols
 



 ● Proficiency with data analysis tools and statistical methods

title: Assistant General Manager, Manufacturing
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* Technical Leadership \& Process Optimization
* Upstream Strategy: Lead the design, optimization, and troubleshooting of Solid\-Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) protocols, including difficult sequences and modification chemistry.
* Downstream Scaling: Direct the scaling up of Preparative HPLC and RP\-HPLC purification methods from analytical to pilot/production scale.
* Troubleshooting: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) to resolve complex synthesis failures, poor solubility issues, and challenging impurity profiles.
* Tech Transfer: Oversee the seamless transfer of peptide processes from the R\&D stage to validation and commercial production batches.
* Operations \& Team Management
* Resource Allocation: Manage a team 22 members of engineers/scientists, assigning daily synthesis, purification, and lyophilization tasks.
* Project Timelines: Ensure projects meet strict delivery schedules while optimizing raw material consumption (resins, protected amino acids, solvents).
* Equipment Oversight: Oversee the calibration, maintenance, and qualification of automated synthesizers, Prep\-HPLC systems, and lyophilizers.
* Data Integrity: Review and sign off on chromatograms, analytical data, Master Batch Records (MBRs), and final batch release reports.
* Compliance Lead: Ensure the laboratory strictly adheres to GLP/GMP guidelines, data integrity standards, and safety regulations.
* SOP Authoring: Author, update, and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), deviation reports, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).


**Qualifications**
**Candidate Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech in Biotechnology or Chemical Engineering OR M.Sc. / Ph.D. in Organic, Analytical, or Biochemistry.
* Experience: 15 to 18\+ years of core industrial experience in peptide chemistry, with at least 2\+ years in a supervisory or team\-leading role.
* Technical Mastery: Deep, provable expertise spanning both upstream chain\-building (cleavage, coupling) and downstream isolation (salt\-exchange, TFF, freeze\-drying).
* Software Literacy: High proficiency in chromatography data software (e.g., Empower, Chromeleon) and data analysis tools.
* Soft Skills: Strong project management, clear cross\-functional communication, and a proven track record of mentoring junior scientists.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Location:**

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**
* Lead day\-to\-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.


**Mid Mile Network Operations**
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.


**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**
* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.


**Workforce \& Shift Leadership**
* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.


**Fleet, Capacity \& Resource Management**
* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.


**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.


**Safety, Security \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.


**Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication**
* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.


**People Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on\-the\-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience** 
 :
   

  

  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid\-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 \- 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high\-volume, time\-sensitive logistics environments.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* Hub \& Mid Mile Operations Management
* Air \& Surface Network Operations
* Shipment Processing \& Transit Management
* Fleet Coordination \& Capacity Utilisation
* Network Planning \& Schedule Adherence
* Service Quality \& Operational Excellence
* Operational MIS \& Performance Analytics
* Safety, Security \& Regulatory Compliance
* Process Improvement \& Productivity Enhancement

 On\-time departure \& arrival adherence, Network connectivity, Schedule adherence

 SLAH %, Misroutes, Misconnections, Shipment processing accuracy, Scan compliance

 Hub throughput, Vehicle turnaround time, Dock utilisation, Productivity per FTE

 **Blue Dart is where you belong**

**Position Overview:**
 The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Hub Operations Management**

* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.


**Mid Mile Network Operations**
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.


**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**
* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.


**Workforce \& Shift Leadership**
* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.


**Fleet, Capacity \& Resource Management**

* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.


**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.

* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.


**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.


**Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication**

* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**The Role:** 




 To lead and oversee the complete production operations of both the Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic manufacturing plants by ensuring products are manufactured safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The Production Head will be responsible for production planning, manpower management, process optimization, capacity utilization, and achieving production targets through effective leadership of Production Supervisors and cross\-functional coordination.  
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




 1\. Production Operations Management  
 



 Lead and oversee daily production activities for both Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic manufacturing plants.  
 



 Ensure production schedules are executed efficiently while meeting quality, cost, and delivery objectives.  
 



 Allocate resources, manpower, and equipment to maximize productivity and plant utilization.  
 



 Monitor production output, efficiency, and adherence to production plans.  
 



  





 2\. Leadership \& Team Management 
 



 Lead, mentor, and develop Production Supervisors and production teams across both plants.  
 



 Define production targets and monitor team performance through regular reviews.  
 



 Build a culture of accountability, discipline, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.  
 



 Ensure adequate manpower planning and succession planning for production functions.  
 



  





 3\. Production Planning \& Coordination 
 



 Coordinate with PPC, Stores, Purchase, QA, QC, Warehouse, Maintenance, and Dispatch to ensure uninterrupted production.  
 



 Review daily production plans and prioritize manufacturing based on business requirements.
 



 Ensure timely availability of raw materials, packing materials, machinery, and manpower.  
 



  





 4\. Process Improvement \& Productivity 
 



 Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce manufacturing cycle time, and optimize resource utilization.  
 



 Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
 



 Monitor production KPIs and drive corrective actions for performance improvement.  
 



  





 5\. Quality \& Compliance 
 



 Ensure all manufacturing activities comply with GMP, SOPs, Batch Manufacturing 
 



 Records (BMR), and applicable regulatory requirements.  
 



 Support QA and QC in investigations related to deviations, non\-conformances, and CAPA implementation.  
 



 Ensure production documentation is complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.  
 



 Prepare both plants for customer audits and future WHO\-GMP certification.  
 



  





 6\. Operational Excellence 
 



 Monitor Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production efficiency, and manufacturing losses.  
 



 Reduce production downtime through effective coordination with Engineering and Maintenance teams.  
 



 Minimize product rejections, rework, wastage, and process deviations.  
 



 Drive continuous improvement projects to enhance manufacturing performance.  
 



  





 7\. Safety \& Compliance 
 



 Ensure adherence to EHS, GMP, and workplace safety practices across both plants.  
 



 Promote safe handling of materials, equipment, and manufacturing processes.  
 



 Ensure production personnel comply with hygiene and safety requirements.  
 



 8\. Reporting \& Performance Monitoring 
 



 Review daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.  
 



 Monitor production KPIs, capacity utilization, manpower efficiency, and manufacturing costs.  
 



 Present operational performance and improvement initiatives to senior management. 
 



  





**Required qualification and skills:** 




 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Industrial 
 



 Engineering, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.  
 



 10–15 years of production experience in Pharmaceuticals, Cosmetics, FMCG, or regulated manufacturing industries.  
 



 Minimum 5 years of experience in a production leadership role managing multiple production lines or manufacturing units.  
 



 Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical and cosmetic manufacturing processes.  
 



 Experience with GMP, WHO\-GMP, ISO standards, documentation, and regulatory compliance.  
 



 Knowledge of production planning, capacity management, batch manufacturing, and process optimization.  
 



 Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
 



 Strong leadership, people management, communication, and decision\-making skills.  
 



 Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Office, and manufacturing reporting tools.
