**About The Role**
 Responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end management of plant stores, warehouse, inventory, material movement and logistics operations** 
 . The role will ensure timely material receipt, storage, issue, internal movement and dispatch while maintaining high inventory accuracy, proper documentation, ERP discipline and cost\-effective logistics operations.
   

  

 The key objective is to ensure the
 **right material, in the right quantity, at the right location, with the right documentation and at the right time** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Stores \& Warehouse Management: Manage day\-to\-day plant stores and warehouse operations, including receiving, unloading, inspection coordination, put\-away, bin management, storage, space utilization, 5S and safety.
* Inward Material Management: Coordinate material receipts with Procurement, QA/QC, Security and Accounts; verify documentation and ensure timely GRN/MRN completion while tracking shortages, damages and discrepancies.
* Material Issue \& Production Support: Ensure timely and accurate material issue to Production, Maintenance, EPC and other departments against approved requisitions, while monitoring line\-side inventory and material returns.
* Inventory Control: Maintain ≥99% inventory accuracy between physical and ERP stock through cycle counts, stock verification, variance analysis, batch/lot/serial traceability and control of slow/non\-moving inventory.
* Logistics \& Transportation: Manage inbound and outbound logistics, vehicle planning and placement, loading, dispatch, delivery tracking, PODs, transporter coordination, freight costs and vehicle utilization.
* ERP / Odoo Management: Ensure accurate and timely ERP/Odoo transactions for GRN, material issue, transfers, returns and dispatches, along with regular stock reconciliation and inventory reporting.
* Documentation \& Compliance: Maintain stores and logistics records, ensure proper documentation for inter\-plant transfers, customer dispatches, imported/bonded materials and support internal, financial, customer and statutory audits.
* Team Management: Lead and supervise storekeepers, warehouse staff, loaders and logistics coordinators; allocate daily activities, monitor productivity, train employees on SOPs, ERP and safety, and drive accountability through KPIs.


**Key Requirements**
* Strong knowledge of Stores \& Warehouse Management
* Inventory planning and control
* Logistics and transportation management
* Hands\-on experience with ERP/Odoo
* Strong MS Excel skills including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and dashboards
* Vendor and transporter coordination
* Team leadership and manpower management
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong documentation and audit discipline
* Good communication and cross\-functional coordination
* Ability to work in a manufacturing/plant environment


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Inventory accuracy: ≥99%
* GRN completion within defined TAT
* Material issue TAT
* Dispatch adherence / OTIF
* Warehouse space utilization
* Stock variance
* Damage/breakage percentage
* Freight cost per MT / MW / shipment
* Vehicle placement adherence
* Slow/non\-moving inventory reduction
* POD submission TAT
* Audit observations
* 5S and safety compliance

****About Business:****

**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India.  Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.
   

  

 Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost\-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.
   

  

 Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.
   

  

 Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
   

  

**Inventory Management:**
 Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.
   

  

 Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.
   

  

 Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.
   

  

 Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.
   

  

 Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.
   

  

**Financial And Budget Management:**
 Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.
   

  

 Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.
   

  

 Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.
   

  

 Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.
   

  

**Operational Coordination And Reporting:**
 Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.
   

  

 Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.
   

  

 Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.
   

  

 Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.
   

  

 Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.
   

  

 Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.
   

  

 Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX\-related procurements and inventory.
   

  

 Release all e\-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.
   

  

 Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.
   

  

 Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.
   

  

**Compliance And Quality Assurance:**
 Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.
   

  

 Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.
   

  

 Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.
   

  

**Technology Integration:**
 Deploy digital tools for real\-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.
   

  

 Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Sites Projects team
   

  

 Marketing department
   

  

 Finance \& Accounts team
   

  

 Quality Assurance Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Vendors
   

  

 Suppliers
   

  

 External agencies
   

  

 Auditors
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
 Strategic Sourcing:
   

  

* Plan and forecast Capex procurement needs based on the projects in pipeline and organization's strategic objectives.
* Formulate contractual terms and conditions for major EPC contracts to secure favorable terms.
* Negotiate with vendors for long\-term contract terms to ensure beneficial agreements.
* Select the bidding process, prepare vendor selection approaches, and vendor evaluation criteria to streamline the procurement process.
* Review RFI and RFP documents, identify potential bidders, and organize pre\-bid meetings to facilitate a competitive bidding process.
* Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations and fact\-based negotiations/e\-auctions to select the best vendors.
* Review Notes for Approval (NFA) for selected bidders and obtain required approvals to ensure compliance with company policies.
* Leverage extensive experience in mining and material handling procurement, including handling mining and EPC contractors, explosives, CHPP, and project monitoring to develop and implement procurement strategies.


**Core Procurement Activities:**
* Understand the Techno\-Commercial strategy and plan for the Business Unit (BU) to implement strategic initiatives for all categories (Group\-wide/BU specific) as per plan.
* Oversee the review of approved PRs from user departments to ensure correctness and completeness of PRs.
* Coordinate with leads in identifying the type and method of procurement based on material/service type, urgency, stock availability, rate contracts, value, and delivery timeline to optimize procurement efficiency.


**Contract Management:**
* Oversee the preparation of contract documents as per protocols and standard templates to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Set up approved contract records within the ERP system to maintain accurate and accessible records.
* Maintain contract documents for future reference and compliance to ensure traceability and accountability.
* Collate Advance Bank Guarantee/Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (ABG/CPBG)/Customs related documents from vendors to secure financial assurances.
* Prepare, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved NFAs to secure long\-term pricing agreements.
* Prepare master outline agreements in ERP systems based on rate contracts to streamline procurement processes.

**Supplier Management:**

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Identify procurement risks for assigned categories using master lists, supply market analysis, long\-term procurement plans, annual procurement plans, and project risk registers to mitigate risks.

* Communicate personal development needs and actively engage in creating and following Individual Development Plans (IDP) for professional growth.
* Develop skills in current and future functional focus areas as per the capability matrix and IDP guidelines to contribute to team versatility.


**Technology Integration:**
* Utilize digital solutions for comprehensive tracking and analysis of capital expenditure projects, ensuring accurate forecasting and budgeting.
* Implement digital tools for project management and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency in Capex initiatives.

 Quality Assurance Team

 Suppliers
   

  

 External agencies

title: BIM Lead / VP – Production
description:
BIM Lead / VP – Production
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — 100% In\-Office (Candidates from anywhere in India welcome to apply; relocation to Ahmedabad required)
 **Experience:** 
 8\+ Years (Multi\-Discipline BIM Production \& Team Leadership)
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Minimum 2\.5\-Year Service Commitment (Employment Bond \+ Strict NDA applicable)
 **Reports To:** 
 Founder / CEO
 



  





 About Us
 



  





**BIM Expert Studio** 
 is a fast\-growing BIM and CAD outsourcing company based in Ahmedabad, India, delivering Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM production services to Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) firms, building surveyors, and MEPF/General Contractors across the United States. We work across multiple project types and disciplines with a production team built to scale.
 



 We're looking for a hands\-on BIM Lead / VP – Production to own end\-to\-end technical delivery, build and lead our modeling team, and become the technical backbone of the company as we scale production capacity.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role — not a purely managerial one. You will be the final technical authority across every discipline we serve (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM), responsible for making sure any project that comes in from a US client — regardless of discipline or project type — can be delivered correctly, on time, and to US AEC documentation standards. You will also build out the production bench itself: hiring, training, and developing modelers and drafters as the team scales.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




1. Own end\-to\-end technical delivery across all disciplines — Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM — for every incoming client project, regardless of discipline or project type.
2. Review incoming project scopes from US clients and determine discipline, LOD, staffing, and timeline requirements.
3. Set up and enforce BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), modeling standards, and QA/QC checkpoints for every project.
4. Directly model, troubleshoot, or unblock any discipline when the team hits a technical wall — you should be able to open any file and solve the problem yourself.
5. Hire, onboard, and train BIM modelers and drafters across disciplines as the team scales; build internal training/SOP material for new hires.
6. Allocate resources and manage capacity planning across multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
7. Run multi\-discipline coordination and clash detection reviews before deliverables go out.
8. Act as the primary technical point of contact for US clients on project\-specific queries, scope clarifications, and escalations.
9. Standardize templates, families, and content libraries across disciplines to improve production speed and consistency.
10. Mentor and develop team leads under you so the production team can eventually run with less day\-to\-day involvement from you.
11. Track and report production KPIs (turnaround time, rework rate, capacity utilization) to leadership.
12. Maintain strict confidentiality of client data, drawings, and business information at all times.



  





 Technical Skills Required
 



  





 1\. Architectural BIM
 



  




1. Full concept\-to\-Construction Documents (CD) production: floor plans, elevations, sections, RCPs, schedules, and detailing
2. Experience across multiple project types — residential (multi\-family/single\-family), commercial, hospitality, healthcare, education, and industrial
3. Revit family creation and library management across LOD 100–500
4. Working knowledge of US code frameworks (IBC, ADA) as they apply to documentation accuracy
5. Renovation, addition, and adaptive\-reuse modeling from existing/as\-built conditions
6. Interior architecture and tenant improvement (TI) documentation



  





 2\. Structural BIM
 



  




1. Steel, concrete, wood\-frame, and light\-gauge structural modeling
2. Rebar detailing and structural shop drawing coordination
3. Framing plans, connections, and structural detailing
4. Translating structural engineers' design intent and calculations into accurate models
5. Foundation, podium, and structural steel detailing
6. Structural clash resolution against architectural and MEPF models



  





 3\. MEPF (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection)
 



  




1. HVAC ductwork, piping, and equipment modeling
2. Electrical power, lighting, low\-voltage systems, and panel schedule modeling
3. Plumbing supply, waste, and vent system modeling
4. Fire protection and sprinkler system layout and modeling
5. Multi\-system MEPF coordination for clash\-free installation
6. Spool and fabrication drawing generation to support prefabrication workflows



  





 4\. Scan\-to\-BIM / Reality Capture
 



  




1. Point cloud registration and cleanup (Recap, Cyclone, or equivalent)
2. As\-built modeling directly from point cloud/laser scan data
3. Existing conditions documentation for renovation and retrofit projects
4. Accuracy validation and QA of scan\-derived models against source data
5. Integrating scan\-based models into ongoing design/coordination workflows



  





 5\. Software \& Platform Proficiency
 



  




1. Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP)
2. AutoCAD / AutoCAD MEP
3. Navisworks Manage (clash detection and 4D sequencing)
4. Autodesk Recap / Recap Pro (point cloud processing)
5. BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
6. Civil 3D (added advantage)
7. Dynamo or other BIM automation/scripting tools (added advantage)
8. MS Project and Excel for scheduling and resource tracking



  





 6\. Standards, Process \& Coordination
 



  




1. BIM Execution Plan (BEP) development and enforcement
2. LOD (Level of Development) specification, assignment, and QA
3. Familiarity with US AEC documentation standards (AIA/NCS conventions)
4. Working exposure to ISO 19650 principles
5. Multi\-discipline clash detection and resolution workflows
6. Standardizing templates and content libraries across projects and disciplines



  





 7\. Leadership \& Team Management
 



  




1. Hiring, onboarding, and training BIM modelers and drafters
2. Resource allocation and capacity planning across concurrent projects
3. Production quality control and deadline/SLA management
4. Direct client\-facing communication with US\-based AEC clients
5. Mentoring team leads and building internal training material/SOPs
6. Managing any vendor or subcontracted production resources, if applicable



  





 Requirements
 



  




* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on BIM/CAD production experience, with demonstrated exposure across
 **at least three** 
 of the four core disciplines (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM)
* Prior experience leading or building a production team (hiring, training, and managing modelers/drafters)
* Experience working with or delivering to US\-based AEC clients strongly preferred
* Strong written and verbal English communication for direct client interaction
* Based in or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad for a 100% in\-office role
* Willing to commit to a minimum 2\.5\-year tenure, backed by an employment bond and a strict NDA (given direct exposure to client data and production processes)



  





 What We Offer
 



  




* A senior leadership role shaping production strategy at a company built for scale
* Direct, ongoing exposure to the US AEC market across a wide range of disciplines and project types
* Competitive fixed compensation plus performance\-linked incentives
* A clear growth path into senior/company leadership as the team and client base expand

 send you applications on Mike@mazinfotech.com

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Eunoia Designtech, founded in 2016 and based in Ahmedabad, is a design consultancy focused on transforming bold ideas into practical, high\-impact solutions. The team combines mechanical design, web development, graphic design, branding, printing, and digital marketing to deliver creative work aligned with clear business goals. By deeply understanding each brand’s objectives and audience, Eunoia Designtech creates campaigns and solutions that perform strategically and maximize ROI. The company has partnered with over 150 clients across diverse industries such as FMCG, textiles, real estate, architecture, cosmetics, retail, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and finance. Integrating technology, creativity, and strategy, Eunoia Designtech’s promise is simple: if you can think it, they can develop it.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Operations Manager will oversee daily operations across design, development, and marketing projects to ensure smooth workflows and timely delivery. This full\-time, on\-site role in Ahmedabad involves coordinating cross\-functional teams, optimizing processes, managing resource allocation, and monitoring project progress against timelines and quality standards. The Operations Manager will implement and refine operational policies, maintain documentation, and use data to identify opportunities for efficiency and performance improvement. The role includes collaborating with leadership on planning, budgeting, and capacity management, as well as supporting client servicing teams to meet project requirements and resolve operational issues. The Operations Manager will also help nurture a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and effective communication within the organization.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong operations management skills, including process optimization, workflow design, and resource planning.
* Experience with project management practices, tools, and methodologies in design, development, or marketing environments.
* Ability to coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage priorities, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Solid analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and use insights to drive decisions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on clear, structured reporting and stakeholder updates.
* Proficiency in using productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., project management platforms, spreadsheets, documentation tools).
* Demonstrated experience in a managerial or supervisory role, preferably within a creative, tech, or consulting organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications are a plus.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Understanding of design, web development, and digital marketing workflows is highly beneficial.
